notes.title: Silence->Broken
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4734227/e04c2fea99476d09ddbc5d552a45cb2928722dfc.png[/img]

Hey everyone! 

For those of you who don't know, my name's Victor Burgos (who knew). I have a short little intro already on the General Forums named Beehive->Kick that's pinned if you want more info. 

[b]TL;DR[/b]: Programmer. Former Marine. Game Dev Student Grad.  

A lot of you have been patiently waiting for what the heck this "Outbreak" thing was and I am happy to announce... 

[spoiler]Contagion VR: Outbreak[/spoiler]

[h1]Bubble->Burst[/h1]
Now I know this is definitely not what most of you hoped for. I know you all wanted this to be an update for Contagion itself. Sorry to burst that bubble but please do read on and don't be too ːsteamsaltyː.

[h1]Outbreak->Demo[/h1]
There is a demo and it's actually complete ːsteamhappyː. We're waiting on a few things before releasing it, sadly it's Friday night and a holiday weekend so we'll be publishing...

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4734227/1041c3b11940e4da1b9e6031b1aab1fc3483be6f.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4734227/241ae7997f1c9bb0a12ab3aca6fa9d375674388d.png[/img][/url]
ːsteamsadːːsteamsadːːsteamsadːːsteamsadːːsteamsadːːsteamsadːːsteamsadː

[h1]Outbreak->About[/h1]
Contagion VR: Outbreak is a first-person shooter built from the ground up exclusively for VR. Fully immerse yourself in a world initially familiar to you, and witness it's transformation into something much darker as it rapidly changes right before your eyes.

Assume the role of one of our many characters and experience their stories first hand that would shape them in the mold of who they would eventually become. The end of the world as we know it is filled with horrors the likes of which were never fathomed, but in all the darkness lies a beacon of light, tales of heroism and sacrifices made so others could carry on. Explore highly detailed environments, search for scarce resources and see if you've got what it takes to survive a zombie apocalypse!

We've painstakingly developed every element from the ground up for HTC Vive and Oculus, Contagion VR: Outbreak drops you in the middle of the zombie apocalypse. Fight alone in our single player story driven mode and experience each characters past, or team up and fight alongside your friends in one of our co-op based modes! Have a competitive drive? Do battle against other players in one of our PVP modes and see if you've got what it takes to be crowned king of the VR wasteland!

[list]
[*]VR driven game-play mechanics: Perform physical actions true to life that immerse players deep inside the world of Contagion.
[*]Full single player campaign: Each character has their own history, learn the events each experienced that shaped their personalities and defines who they are today.
[*]A massive arsenal of weapons: Firearms, melee weapons, explosives, and much much more!
[*]Multiple co-op modes: Fight alongside your friends in one of our multiplayer focused modes, or climb the leaderboards in any of our shooting range challenges! 
[*]Challenge other survivors: Have a competitive itch? Hop into one of our PVP multiplayer modes and see if you're good enough to be king of the VR wasteland!
[*]Customize your personal space: Play the game to unlock loot drops and customize your home base to your liking before heading out to battle the infected.
[/list]

[h1]FridayThe13thImage->Delete[/h1]
Turns out that Valve updated the way they do images, I even thought that someone on our team had deleted it, but nope, that's not the case.

[h1]ProjectAgeless->StatusCheck[/h1]
A highly ambitious project that is currently [b]no longer[/b] in development. 

[h1]Contagion(this)->StatusCheck[/h1]
What you've all been waiting for! ːsteamhappyː What the heck is going on with this game?

Sadly, not much. The team did [b]not[/b] have the resources to continue development using the Source SDK. Basically, they did not have a programmer with enough chops to accomplish what they had originally set out to do. 

Which is the main reason they chose to move onto another project that they could accomplish without an actual programmer: Contagion VR: Outbreak using [b]Unreal Engine 4's Blueprints Visual Scripting[/b] system. 

But the core team, even in their silence, have kept Contagion and the community in their hearts, knowing that it was just a matter of time for when they could come back and, if not "finish what they started", at the very least clean up a few things.

[h1]Contagion(this)->VictorModeEnabled[/h1]
So right off the bat folks... I am [b]NOT[/b] a Source SDK programmer and have never touched this archaic thing in my life. I have been programming in UE4 for over 3 years now (BP/UE4++), so that's definitely my forte. 

I have probably just as much time as a C++ programmer and I also know some C# (worked in Unity some). 

What does this mean? My main focus [u][b]is and will be[/b][/u] Contagion VR: Outbreak [i]but[/i] I will be taking out some time to get myself acquainted with Source SDK [b]and[/b] the Contagion Source Code (yes I have access to it).

But real-talk folks... this thing has been through at least three other programmersːsteamfacepalmː, it's over four years old, any updates on my part will be the easy kindːsteammockingː. Bug-fixing being the priority, anything else would be very slow in the making (if at all).

[h1]VictorBurgos->Promise[/h1]
With all that said, I hereby state the following:
[list]
[*] I will look at the Contagion Source code
[*] I will learn how to modify the code without breaking things
[*] I will make bug-fixing my priority
[/list]

And that's it. There's no timeline, no other promises. I am [b]not[/b] doing this because I was told to do it. I am doing this on my own accord. It's the same for this announcement. 

[h1]VictorBurgos->RealTalk[/h1]
I am a straight-up, honest and down to earth guy. I don't hold my punches. My filter is practically non-existent. That doesn't mean I can't be tactful though. Just like everyone else, I am a real person behind this keyboard. Unlike most people, I do not hide behind an online persona. 

If anyone has any specific questions or concerns about this announcement, please do not hesitate to comment below.

My website is: http://www.VictorBurgosGames.com (make sure to sign up for my newsletter ːsteammockingː)
I can also be reached on Twitter: https://twitter.com/victorburgosG3


[b]Post-Original Announcement[/b]

[h1]GameDevelopment->Hard[/h1]
But yeah, let's be real here. Game Development takes time, effort and money. The game's been out for over 4 years now, some games don't even get any support after launching. So be grateful for the support you had (even if you think it wasn't enough) 

Also, unless you all want to donate lots of $$$ to my bank account in an attempt to sway me into putting more time into Contagion Source SDK, I do have to eat. So gotta make sure my primary tasks are completed first and foremost. Like I said, I'll do what I can in my spare time learning it. It won't be a quick and easy process sadly. I wish it were. I wish I could just push one button and give you all what you wanted.

[h1]ContagionVROutbreak->Pricing[/h1]
While I definitely do not have the authority on pricing. I can guarantee you that it will [b]NOT[/b] be free. The game has been in development for over a year now and has a lot of money sunk into it. Money that needs to be reimbursed in some way. 

Contagion != Contagion VR: Outbreak. They are two separate game that just share the same universe. The demo [u]WILL[/u] be free however. And I did put a special surprise in there for Non-VR users. (But don't tell anyone on my team ːsteammockingː)

As far as a discount, I could see that potentially being a possibility. Not sure how much of a discount, I suppose that would depend on the price. 

[h1]ContagionOutbreak->NonVR[/h1]
So, the TL;DR version: Once I have all the systems in place for VR, I will be looking into Non-VR and we'll be dropping the VR from the name(I don't see why we would keep it)

In between Source SDK learning/bug fixing and main VR work, I do plan on continuing adding things for Non-VR players. However, what those things may entail in the final product remains to be seen. If there's going to be anything "official" announced for Non-VR players it will be at a later date after making sure we get any and all kinks out of the way. So, I suppose you could consider this a precursor to a leak, if anything, on my part.

Things like PvP is iffy. Who has the actual advantage here? If it were PC vs Console in an FPS we would say PC all the way. But now, it's VR vs Non-VR. A VR gamer can shoot around corner and over object with ease and not put their whole body collision at play while the Non-VR player has no choice really. Things like that are what I am thinking about. Coop Contagion, I don't think anyone would care if their buddy was in VR or Non-VR. If anything that would be the focus, that and the Single Player campaign.

We are looking into having Non-VR support alongside VR players. Once I've fleshed out the main gameplay systems, I'll have to double back and do a pass on the FPS Character and basically see what I can do and what I can't do. 

Obviously it would be awesome to have a completely 100% 1:1 functionality, even if the inputs/interactivity is different. But that's a lot of time to digest and figure out the best way to do that.

The game was created for VR first and foremost, the rest of the team didn't even think about having Non-VR support until I mentioned that it was possible. 

They are of course excited about that and I am sure you all would be also. But, who knows how many additional systems I would have to create to allow full Non-VR support.

Remember everything in the game is as if you were there in "real life" so the whole inventory system is basically on your body or backpack. So that's one system I'd have to create for 2D. And I am sure there are other things I haven't thought about. 

Implementation-wise, I don't think it's going to be hard at all. I am just going to be creating an FPS pawn (which technically already exists) alongside our VR pawn. Design-wise, I think that's going to be our major issue. Ensuring a 1:1 experience for both types of players.

[h1]Deej->Speaks[/h1]
I thought I would chime in with my 2 cents real quick. When I joined the team in an official capacity I saw that development on Contagion was at a standstill. I got an education about past missteps by asking questions and got plenty of answers. There were just a few developers active and no direction from the top, I believed everyone who was left when they expressed to me a desire to turn things around, and so we set out to try and do just that.

There was no active programmer and let's be honest here, without a dedicated programmer "real" progress is not possible. We did what we could with a skeleton crew and we managed to produce a couple of campaign maps (Camp Whitner and Montclair) and release a beta of Flatline game mode. We heard loud and clear community complaints and are still listening to this day.

We did have expectations that we were going to start growing the community again, that was always the plan. We had acquired a new programmer who seemed capable and we all agreed we needed to fix up the game while releasing additional free content updates. However gradually it became apparent that we were understaffed in over our heads and our programmer was starting to fade quickly and having just released Flatline we were once again in search of a programmer.

Stability issues aside with Contagion (and I know there are plenty), the top priority for me was wanting to fix the matchmaking system which I thought was awful. Watching people play Contagion the biggest issue I observed was people trying to simply play the game with their friends, it was a nightmare. If we can actually fix that is anyone's guess. It's just one of many things I'd like to fix in Contagion but as Victor said, Source engine is a nightmare and we're not making any promises, but we'll see what we can do.

Fast forward more than a year we decided if Contagion was ever going to stand a chance of getting fixed, we needed another project to put out so we could actually afford to hire someone that would be able to do just that. We started working on Contagion VR Outbreak without any programmer support and in a short time had a solid playable prototype. All signs were looking positive and I requested permission to interview and hire a full time programmer. I wanted a lead programmer who was capable, hungry, and had as much passion for his work as I did. Several interviews later, I believed I had found him.

As the new project lead developer on Contagion VR Outbreak, I had not had the chance to interview anyone for this position in the past and so having made my decision that Victor was the candidate I had been looking for, when we were able to secure him full time I was more than excited. Victor has expressed a desire to want to try and fix some of what's broken in Contagion and plans to try and do just that. Will we be able to fix everything that everyone wants and in a timely fashion? No promises but we hear you, and want the same thing so let's just see what we can manage and when we know, we promise to let you know.

Looking forward, we are going to be looking for a full time community manager for Outbreak. It's a full time job that requires managing of Steam forums, social media platforms, and is a position we should have had for Contagion a long time ago. We want to avoid making the same mistakes we did with Contagion in Outbreak. So with that said, we will be hiring someone to fill that position and pledge do a better job on that front moving forward. We are also discussing plans to host weekly Twitch streams to share updates with the community and have Q&A sessions to gather feedback on things they would like to see in Outbreak.

We know undoubtedly that some will be disappointed with this announcement. I am going to however say that it is not outside the realm of possibility that Outbreak will be a VR only game. I have expressed the desire to the team to at some point after getting Outbreak released and out of Early Access, that we could and should consider setting up support for non-VR users. This is something that we are all in agreement about and because we are using Unreal Engine to develop Outbreak, definitely not outside our capability.

That's all I have to say, I hope you'll give us a chance. Those of you who have stuck around all this time and contributed Workshop content we thank you.

notes.title: Silence->Broken
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4734227/e04c2fea99476d09ddbc5d552a45cb2928722dfc.png[/img]

Hey everyone! 

For those of you who don't know, my name's Victor Burgos (who knew). I have a short little intro already on the General Forums named Beehive->Kick that's pinned if you want more info. 

[b]TL;DR[/b]: Programmer. Former Marine. Game Dev Student Grad.  

A lot of you have been patiently waiting for what the heck this "Outbreak" thing was and I am happy to announce... 

[spoiler]Contagion VR: Outbreak[/spoiler]

[h1]Bubble->Burst[/h1]
Now I know this is definitely not what most of you hoped for. I know you all wanted this to be an update for Contagion itself. Sorry to burst that bubble but please do read on and don't be too ːsteamsaltyː.

[h1]Outbreak->Demo[/h1]
There is a demo and it's actually complete ːsteamhappyː. We're waiting on a few things before releasing it, sadly it's Friday night and a holiday weekend so we'll be publishing...

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4734227/1041c3b11940e4da1b9e6031b1aab1fc3483be6f.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4734227/241ae7997f1c9bb0a12ab3aca6fa9d375674388d.png[/img][/url]
ːsteamsadːːsteamsadːːsteamsadːːsteamsadːːsteamsadːːsteamsadːːsteamsadː

[h1]Outbreak->About[/h1]
Contagion VR: Outbreak is a first-person shooter built from the ground up exclusively for VR. Fully immerse yourself in a world initially familiar to you, and witness it's transformation into something much darker as it rapidly changes right before your eyes.

Assume the role of one of our many characters and experience their stories first hand that would shape them in the mold of who they would eventually become. The end of the world as we know it is filled with horrors the likes of which were never fathomed, but in all the darkness lies a beacon of light, tales of heroism and sacrifices made so others could carry on. Explore highly detailed environments, search for scarce resources and see if you've got what it takes to survive a zombie apocalypse!

We've painstakingly developed every element from the ground up for HTC Vive and Oculus, Contagion VR: Outbreak drops you in the middle of the zombie apocalypse. Fight alone in our single player story driven mode and experience each characters past, or team up and fight alongside your friends in one of our co-op based modes! Have a competitive drive? Do battle against other players in one of our PVP modes and see if you've got what it takes to be crowned king of the VR wasteland!

[list]
[*]VR driven game-play mechanics: Perform physical actions true to life that immerse players deep inside the world of Contagion.
[*]Full single player campaign: Each character has their own history, learn the events each experienced that shaped their personalities and defines who they are today.
[*]A massive arsenal of weapons: Firearms, melee weapons, explosives, and much much more!
[*]Multiple co-op modes: Fight alongside your friends in one of our multiplayer focused modes, or climb the leaderboards in any of our shooting range challenges! 
[*]Challenge other survivors: Have a competitive itch? Hop into one of our PVP multiplayer modes and see if you're good enough to be king of the VR wasteland!
[*]Customize your personal space: Play the game to unlock loot drops and customize your home base to your liking before heading out to battle the infected.
[/list]

[h1]FridayThe13thImage->Delete[/h1]
Turns out that Valve updated the way they do images, I even thought that someone on our team had deleted it, but nope, that's not the case.

[h1]ProjectAgeless->StatusCheck[/h1]
A highly ambitious project that is currently [b]no longer[/b] in development. 

[h1]Contagion(this)->StatusCheck[/h1]
What you've all been waiting for! ːsteamhappyː What the heck is going on with this game?

Sadly, not much. The team did [b]not[/b] have the resources to continue development using the Source SDK. Basically, they did not have a programmer with enough chops to accomplish what they had originally set out to do. 

Which is the main reason they chose to move onto another project that they could accomplish without an actual programmer: Contagion VR: Outbreak using [b]Unreal Engine 4's Blueprints Visual Scripting[/b] system. 

But the core team, even in their silence, have kept Contagion and the community in their hearts, knowing that it was just a matter of time for when they could come back and, if not "finish what they started", at the very least clean up a few things.

[h1]Contagion(this)->VictorModeEnabled[/h1]
So right off the bat folks... I am [b]NOT[/b] a Source SDK programmer and have never touched this archaic thing in my life. I have been programming in UE4 for over 3 years now (BP/UE4++), so that's definitely my forte. 

I have probably just as much time as a C++ programmer and I also know some C# (worked in Unity some). 

What does this mean? My main focus [u][b]is and will be[/b][/u] Contagion VR: Outbreak [i]but[/i] I will be taking out some time to get myself acquainted with Source SDK [b]and[/b] the Contagion Source Code (yes I have access to it).

But real-talk folks... this thing has been through at least three other programmersːsteamfacepalmː, it's over four years old, any updates on my part will be the easy kindːsteammockingː. Bug-fixing being the priority, anything else would be very slow in the making (if at all).

[h1]VictorBurgos->Promise[/h1]
With all that said, I hereby state the following:
[list]
[*] I will look at the Contagion Source code
[*] I will learn how to modify the code without breaking things
[*] I will make bug-fixing my priority
[/list]

And that's it. There's no timeline, no other promises. I am [b]not[/b] doing this because I was told to do it. I am doing this on my own accord. It's the same for this announcement. 

[h1]VictorBurgos->RealTalk[/h1]
I am a straight-up, honest and down to earth guy. I don't hold my punches. My filter is practically non-existent. That doesn't mean I can't be tactful though. Just like everyone else, I am a real person behind this keyboard. Unlike most people, I do not hide behind an online persona. 

If anyone has any specific questions or concerns about this announcement, please do not hesitate to comment below.

My website is: http://www.VictorBurgosGames.com (make sure to sign up for my newsletter ːsteammockingː)
I can also be reached on Twitter: https://twitter.com/victorburgosG3


[b]Post-Original Announcement[/b]

[h1]GameDevelopment->Hard[/h1]
But yeah, let's be real here. Game Development takes time, effort and money. The game's been out for over 4 years now, some games don't even get any support after launching. So be grateful for the support you had (even if you think it wasn't enough) 

Also, unless you all want to donate lots of $$$ to my bank account in an attempt to sway me into putting more time into Contagion Source SDK, I do have to eat. So gotta make sure my primary tasks are completed first and foremost. Like I said, I'll do what I can in my spare time learning it. It won't be a quick and easy process sadly. I wish it were. I wish I could just push one button and give you all what you wanted.

[h1]ContagionVROutbreak->Pricing[/h1]
While I definitely do not have the authority on pricing. I can guarantee you that it will [b]NOT[/b] be free. The game has been in development for over a year now and has a lot of money sunk into it. Money that needs to be reimbursed in some way. 

Contagion != Contagion VR: Outbreak. They are two separate game that just share the same universe. The demo [u]WILL[/u] be free however. And I did put a special surprise in there for Non-VR users. (But don't tell anyone on my team ːsteammockingː)

As far as a discount, I could see that potentially being a possibility. Not sure how much of a discount, I suppose that would depend on the price. 

[h1]ContagionOutbreak->NonVR[/h1]
So, the TL;DR version: Once I have all the systems in place for VR, I will be looking into Non-VR and we'll be dropping the VR from the name(I don't see why we would keep it)

In between Source SDK learning/bug fixing and main VR work, I do plan on continuing adding things for Non-VR players. However, what those things may entail in the final product remains to be seen. If there's going to be anything "official" announced for Non-VR players it will be at a later date after making sure we get any and all kinks out of the way. So, I suppose you could consider this a precursor to a leak, if anything, on my part.

Things like PvP is iffy. Who has the actual advantage here? If it were PC vs Console in an FPS we would say PC all the way. But now, it's VR vs Non-VR. A VR gamer can shoot around corner and over object with ease and not put their whole body collision at play while the Non-VR player has no choice really. Things like that are what I am thinking about. Coop Contagion, I don't think anyone would care if their buddy was in VR or Non-VR. If anything that would be the focus, that and the Single Player campaign.

We are looking into having Non-VR support alongside VR players. Once I've fleshed out the main gameplay systems, I'll have to double back and do a pass on the FPS Character and basically see what I can do and what I can't do. 

Obviously it would be awesome to have a completely 100% 1:1 functionality, even if the inputs/interactivity is different. But that's a lot of time to digest and figure out the best way to do that.

The game was created for VR first and foremost, the rest of the team didn't even think about having Non-VR support until I mentioned that it was possible. 

They are of course excited about that and I am sure you all would be also. But, who knows how many additional systems I would have to create to allow full Non-VR support.

Remember everything in the game is as if you were there in "real life" so the whole inventory system is basically on your body or backpack. So that's one system I'd have to create for 2D. And I am sure there are other things I haven't thought about. 

Implementation-wise, I don't think it's going to be hard at all. I am just going to be creating an FPS pawn (which technically already exists) alongside our VR pawn. Design-wise, I think that's going to be our major issue. Ensuring a 1:1 experience for both types of players.

[h1]Deej->Speaks[/h1]
I thought I would chime in with my 2 cents real quick. When I joined the team in an official capacity I saw that development on Contagion was at a standstill. I got an education about past missteps by asking questions and got plenty of answers. There were just a few developers active and no direction from the top, I believed everyone who was left when they expressed to me a desire to turn things around, and so we set out to try and do just that.

There was no active programmer and let's be honest here, without a dedicated programmer "real" progress is not possible. We did what we could with a skeleton crew and we managed to produce a couple of campaign maps (Camp Whitner and Montclair) and release a beta of Flatline game mode. We heard loud and clear community complaints and are still listening to this day.

We did have expectations that we were going to start growing the community again, that was always the plan. We had acquired a new programmer who seemed capable and we all agreed we needed to fix up the game while releasing additional free content updates. However gradually it became apparent that we were understaffed in over our heads and our programmer was starting to fade quickly and having just released Flatline we were once again in search of a programmer.

Stability issues aside with Contagion (and I know there are plenty), the top priority for me was wanting to fix the matchmaking system which I thought was awful. Watching people play Contagion the biggest issue I observed was people trying to simply play the game with their friends, it was a nightmare. If we can actually fix that is anyone's guess. It's just one of many things I'd like to fix in Contagion but as Victor said, Source engine is a nightmare and we're not making any promises, but we'll see what we can do.

All signs were looking positive and I requested permission to interview and hire a full time programmer. Victor has expressed a desire to want to try and fix some of what's broken in Contagion and plans to try and do just that. Will we be able to fix everything that everyone wants and in a timely fashion? No promises but we hear you, and want the same thing so let's just see what we can manage and when we know, we promise to let you know.

Looking forward, we are going to be looking for a full time community manager for Outbreak. It's a full time job that requires managing of Steam forums, social media platforms, and is a position we should have had for Contagion a long time ago. We want to avoid making the same mistakes we did with Contagion in Outbreak. So with that said, we will be hiring someone to fill that position and pledge do a better job on that front moving forward. We are also discussing plans to host weekly Twitch streams to share updates with the community and have Q&A sessions to gather feedback on things they would like to see in Outbreak.

We know undoubtedly that some will be disappointed with this announcement. I am going to however say that it is not outside the realm of possibility that Outbreak will be a VR only game. notes.content:
[h1]Wait...Contagion Update?![/h1]

Well, it might have taken the better part of forever, but we've got another update rolling out.

First off; a big, huge props and thank you to CCL sama for providing fixes to navmeshes for bunches of maps. Lots of zombie nav weirdness fixes and all around improved navigation should be expected.

We also have rebuilt the workshop tool from the ground up, making it a lot more usable, pretty, and bug-free. 

There is also some very exciting new stuff coming up on the horizon soon, but we wanted to get something out since it had been so very long since Contagion got any proper love. While I know this isnt the update many of you were hoping for, we are still determined to fix all the issues left in the game and add the features that need to be added. Things are not moving at the speed any of us would like, but they are still moving.

Thank you to you all for being patient (and thank you as well to those of you whose patience has worn down. We're gonna work on earning it back)

Welcome back to Friday, this week will be a special Contagion "Friday Frenzy." We will be playing the brand new Escape the Dead map created by the one and only Vagrant. Be sure to join us as we play Contagion and give away a couple copies!

I am happy to announce a few pieces of good news on the Contagion update front. Valve has finally granted Pablo the access he needs on their end so he can continue working on updates. The team tells me that there is another workshop update that they are putting the final touches on and should be ready to push out in the near future. With the team getting back in to the grove now that Pablo has joined us you can expect more updates and fixes coming along. I will keep you up to date with what info I can when the team shares it with me. 

You can watch the Stream [url=http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0]-HERE[/url]

[h1]Escape the Dead[/h1]
[img]http://s23.postimg.org/ujtxow2mj/ce_escapethedead.jpg[/img]

Escape the dead is a free mod. Players must survive a mass of zombies using their stealth and team player skills. Each escape route is generated randomly and depending on the individuals choices others may be unlocked. Quests are also available but are optional and not part of the main game play. This is the final release version of Escape the Dead, and we are excited to test our skills against it.

[h1]Change to Sunday stream[/h1]
This week we will be trying out something different for Sunday. Instead of playing an indie on Sunday we will be playing the new Doom. We are making this change for a few reasons. The first should be obvious we really want to play Doom. Second we are still trying to establish ourselves and how we should handle our Twitch streams. This is a test run to see what people think.

notes.title: Workshop update live now!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/Contagion_Store_Announcement_Preview.png[/img]

As many of you know our new team member Pablo has been hard at work deep in the Contagion code. Well today I am pleased to announce that the first of many new update's for Contagion is now live. 

[h1]This update includes several fixes on the Workshop side of things:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The 100 MB cap for mods has been removed. Mods are now only limited in size to what storage space the creator has avalible on their Steam cloud. 
[*] Tags have been fixed to allow proper filtering in Steam.
[/list]

As I said there are more updates in the works and will be happy to announce those when they are ready. Pablo wanted to share with all of you what updates will be coming in the future.

[list]
[h1]Log files[/h1]
[*]Purpose: Giving the user the option of sending a file with the problem that they are having. This reduces time in investigating and fixing the bug.

[h1]Translation to different languages[/h1]
[*]Purpose: Making the life easier to non-english players.
 
[h1]Fix mod modification[/h1]
[*]Purpose: Sometimes, when attempting to modify an existing mod, the error "you have not selected a file" displays. This fix would resolve this issue.

[h1]Add functionality to inform the user of how much space he/she wil have
remaining after the mod is uploaded[/h1]
[*]Purpose: This allows the user to be better informed of cloud storage limitations.

[h1]Add additional tags[/h1]
[*]Purpose: More tags.

[h1]Provide a default image in mod creation and provide a warning that "The upload will not stop due to lack of an image' if the use has not provided an image[/h1]
[*]Purpose: Does not restrict mod upload due to lack of an image.
 
[h1]Provide an percentage status of the upload[/h1]
[*]Purpose: This allows the user to be aware of the upload progress.
[/list]

This is only some of of the updates in the works. Many more updates are on their way and I will share what information I can when it is provided to me.

-The Contagion Team

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-05-22_FridayFrenzy/Friday_Frenzy_Preview.png[/img][/url]

We've been receiving a great deal of positive feedback from our weekly Contagion Friday Frenzy Stream & Giveaway and will be keeping it a regular event. For those that are unfamiliar we jump in game with fans, play and answer questions regarding what we're up to, and run a raffle in our Twitch channel as well as hand out a few keys via my personal Twitter account giving away copies of Contagion either to be used or shared with friends and/or family!

You can watch the Stream [url=http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0]-HERE[/url]

Don't forget to catch our-

Join Brian "Tatsur0" and David "Terranwookie" this Sunday as we Stream & Giveaway copies of Indies every Sunday from Noon - 4PM & 8PM - Midnight PST (GMT - 08:00) Check out this Sunday's games! These two were recommended by you!

notes.title: Contagion Update for the new year!
notes.content:
[h1]Contagion Update out! Now with 100% less holiday cheer![/h1]

I don't know about you guys, but I used to be terrible at taking my Christmas tree down. It would stick around until it became a bona fide fire hazard. But eventually, it found it's way to the curb, and a nice man would come and take it away to the [strike]Old Christmas Trees Home[/strike].

Anyway, now we have a plastic Christmas tree and we promptly put it away after it's all said and done. I don't know what the moral of that story is, but the new update is out and all our old, out of season holiday decorations have been stowed safely away before they get the chance to burn the joint down. The old maps are back to their gritty, zombie bitten selves and the zombies are no longer as cheerful as they once were.

[strike]The official servers will be updated shortly; the patch will be out before they are updated, but we'll try to keep the downtime to a minimum.[/strike] [b]The servers should now all be up and running with the latest patch![/b]

The changelog is short and sweet, but here it is:

-Removed Holiday content
-Removed Holiday option from multiplayer menu
-Bugfix in ContagionWorkshop.exe; missing tags now available

Thanks to everyone out there who's been patient with us (aw hell, and thanks to those who have not. Someone's got to keep us on our toes!) Now that we're all done with the eggnog, We've got a bunch of new, seasonally appropriate, potentially dangerous stuff brewing downstairs. We should have some more substantial updates coming soon!  

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: I warned you about the updates, bro
notes.content:
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-12-22_WinterSale/wintersale2015.png[/img]

[h1]I told you dog[/h1]

Got a nice little hotfix out and about, fixing a few of the issues that have been lingering in Flatline. I've just been handed a peice of paper with the following list of [strike]demands[/strike] changes:

[list]
[*]Flatline Bug Fix
	[list]
	[*]Fix for shop items not spawning in correctly (YAY!)
	[/list]

[b]Flatline Beta Changes[/b]

[*]Last update we put in a new movement control system for the zombies, this update primarily improves on that system and makes it more flexible and should make the difficulty scaling feel much better.  We did an initial rebalance on this and will continue iterating for future updates but wanted to get it in your hands to experience right away!
	
	[list]
	[*]Zombies walking speed scale system improved scaling!
	[*]System is more flexible and while you will still see slower zombies there is a much better mixture of faster zombies mixed in
	[*]Gradually as you progress from wave to wave you will see more and more faster zombies and less slower ones
	[/list]
[/list]

Short but sweet! Please post any opinions/love mail/complaints in the Flatline Beta forums; you guys know the drill.

Once again, we hope that everyone out there has a great holiday.  We'll see you soon!

*CHRISTMAS EVE EDIT*
In our haste to get the patch up and running yesterday I forgot to include some important files that, you know, the game needs to work right. Things have since been updated! The zombie speeds in Flatline should be working now.

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Winter..Winter never changes: Awesome Sales and Contagion updates!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-12-22_WinterSale/wintersale2015.png[/img]

[h1]Another winter, another winter sale![/h1]

 'Tis the season for wallet draining videogame deals. Contagion is 80% off, and as slick a deal as it's ever been with the Contagion and Soundtrack bundle. It's the feel-good deal of the season!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-12-22_WinterSale/contagionwintersale2015.png[/img][/url] 

[h1]Contagion Update![/h1]

On top of being a swell deal and an ideal gift as-is, we've got a winter themed update out the door and ready to play. We've also listened to your input from last time, so now there's an option to turn off the silly zombie attachments if that sort of thing just doesn't do it for you. We've got a sleighful of seasonally appropriate updates as well as a coal-bag's worth of not-so-festive content, but they are all worth celebrating none the less. Check out the whole list:
[list]
Flatline Beta Changes
	[*]Zombies walking speed now scales
		[list]
		[*]Waves 1-2 all zombies move slower
		[*]Waves 3-5 half of the zombies move fast
		[*]Waves 6-10 all zombies move fast
		[/list]
	[*]Slight nerf to number of overall zombies and riot zombies in each wave
	[*]Numerous map bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Game update, Flatline public beta avaliable now!
notes.content:
Hello my favorite Contagion Fans!

[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015_12-11_Flatline_beta/flatline_beta.png[/img]

It’s taken its sweet time, and we know you all have been very patient with us. We're very happy to announce that we're finally ready to unleash the beast that is Flatline!

Just a recap in case you have not been privy to the details: Flatline is a Survivor only (no player zombies!), round based mode where you and 3 of your besties face wave after wave of zombies. Each successive wave will throw more and more zombies at you. But fear not, because after you complete a wave you will have access to better weapons, and sometimes items you need to gain access to more of the map. Places you will definitely need to be in order to ultimately make it out of there alive.

Do you die as often as I do? Problem solved! As long as at least one person survives, everyone will respawn when the wave ends. This will give you time to rearm and prepare for the next wave. If everyone dies... well, game over. Zombies win and take over the world. [strike]MAYBE I SHOULD BE BETTER AT VIDEOGAMES![/strike]

Ultimately, the goal is to survive to the final wave; a wave you surely cannot win. However, fortune smiles upon you and it looks like help is on the way. The question is, can you last long enough? Who knows! you'll have to play to find out.

And just a heads up, we're officially only supporting a max of 4 players in Flatline for now. We've seen some performance issues arise with larger numbers so until we get that optimized we're sticking with what's fun. Feel free to experiment with more players on your own servers, but be aware that there may be some issues involved with that for now.

The good news is the update should be going live as of the posting of this announcement. The servers have been updated (a little bit ahead of schedule, so sorry for anyone trying to get their Contagion on earlier today if you were having trouble connecting to an official server) and we'll have some Flatline only servers up and running very soon.

Here is a quasi-inclusive changelog:
[list]
[*] Flatline beta!
[*] numerous ce_montclair bug fixes
[*] new cockroach spectator mode, when you are near a survivor press USE and you can attach to their shoulder.
[*] remington870's red dot is now more realistic
[*] updates to a handful of existing props and materials
[*] optimization of lots of materials
[/list]

In the mean time, if you just cant wait for Steam to update Contagion, please check out the Flatline trailer:
[url=https://youtu.be/-sfXv-nBblw][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015_12-11_Flatline_beta/flatline_youtube.jpg[/img][/url]

We've also prepared a couple of new forums: Public Beta Discussion and Public Beta Bug Reports. Please direct your flatline discussion, issues, ideas and (hopefully not too many!) bug reports into the appropriate one of these two smoking hot, brand new, almost-still-in-the-wrapper forums.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/13/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015_12-11_Flatline_beta/beta_forums.png[/img][/url]

We hope you enjoy playing this as much as we had working on it (hopefully more!). Let us know what you think, and keep your eyes peeled for more updates soon.

Thanks everyone!

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Post-Halloween Update
notes.content:
Hello Contagion fans!

We hope you had a fun Halloween, hopefully filled with more treats than tricks. Over here on Team Contagion we have been hammering away on another update. The big one here is restoring the maps to their non-scary pre-Halloween versions, albeit with a handful of fixes sprinkled into them here and there.

We've also addressed a recent crashing issue that was brought to light by our newest map, Montclair. Although it seemed to be possible in any map, it was most prevalent there. The fix involved optimizing how zombies are removed (well, specifically, some zombies were not being removed when they should have been). If you have been having crashing issues ever since the last patch, you definitely want to check things out now.

Hunted has been slightly modified as well. Now when you ping another survivors phone, nearby zombies will be attracted to the sound. We're hoping this should spice up all things hunted a little bit, as we've been having a lot of fun with it. We've also increased the radius that your phone can "see" other player's phones to accommodate the play style of larger maps.

There's lots more coming down the pipe, so keep your eyes pealed for more updates!

Also, just for anyone who hasen't seen it yet, don't forget to check out the soundtrack:

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/407920][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-10-26_Halloween/Contagion_OST_Art_620.jpg[/img][/url]

The sale may be over, but it's still a pretty hot deal for $1.99 in my opinion. I know I am biased, but really, check it out if you like the music in the game. There's a lot of stuff in the soundtrack that isn't in the game (yet!), and its all very good music. Plus, it's got that fantastic track from the trailer! I've run the numbers, and it's statistically improbable for you to lose on this deal.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407920

Thanks again everyone, see you next time!

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Halloween hotfix!
notes.content:
Happy Halloween!

Got a small hotfix coming out soon that should address a number of issues that came up with the recent patch. It wouldn't be game development if fixing one thing didn't break 3 more! Anyway, the important bits of the changelog is as follows:

- Added cvar to turn off pumpkins on zombies: allow_zombie_holiday. 0 for off and 1 for on. 1 is default for Halloween.
- fixed stealth melee kill bugs related to the zombie pumpkin heads
- numerous bugfixes and tweaks to ce_montclair
- fixed shortcut exploit in ce_barlowsquare


We know there are still a few more issues floating around but we are working hard to get them ironed out. In the mean time, we wanted to quickly get out an update with what we are able to fix now.

All of us at Monochrome hope that everyone has a great Halloween, and if you are going out trick-or-treating, going to a party, and/or participating in anything "cool" [ed. note: staying at home and playing videogames is cool, I don't care what anyone says], please stay safe and have fun!

-The Contagion Team

notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-10-29_Halloween/halloween_sale_pumpkins.png[/img][/url]
It's time for the Steam Halloween sale! That means awesome deals (Contagion is 80% off!) and a game update with a scary amount of new content. Check it out:

[h1]CE_Montclair[/h1]
[h1]CH_Montclair[/h1]

[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-10-29_Halloween/238430_2015-10-29_00001.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-10-29_Halloween/238430_2015-10-29_00001_th.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-10-29_Halloween/238430_2015-10-29_00006.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-10-29_Halloween/238430_2015-10-29_00006_th.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-10-29_Halloween/238430_2015-10-29_00020.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-10-29_Halloween/238430_2015-10-29_00020_th.jpg[/img][/url]

Montclair is one of the biggest maps we've made, right up there with Barlow Square in overall scale. It's a blast to play and we are sure you guys are going to love it.

On top of a brand new map, we've added tons of Halloween themed content added to almost all the existing maps. They're hard to miss, but we also have added Jack-o-Lantern headed zombies with ever so satisfying headshot gibs.

Among a bunch of little tweaks and fixes, a big non-Halloween related upgrade includes a feature for all Escape mode maps, where extra zombie lives are granted to all zombie players when the Survivors hit certain objectives. So if you're the type that quickly spend all your zombie lives and you frequently find yourself buzzing around as a cockroach while everyone else is having fun, this will get you back in the game and back in action without having to wait for the round to restart.

And if you haven't yet, do yourself a favor and check out the recently released Official Soundtrack. Get it while it's hot and at a nice, tasty discount:

notes.title: Contagion - Game-mode Specific Servers are up now, DLC Progress, and more!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-07-14_Contagion_DLC_Weapons/DLC_Art_620x355.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Game-Mode Specific Servers[/h1]
As there were many requests we worked with Gameservers who hosts our Official Contagion servers to set it up so we could create Game-Mode Specific Servers.

Look for Official Contagion Escape, Extraction, Hunted, and Classic Panic Servers!

If you run into issues we should know about regarding the above please refer to the pinned discussion-
http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/527274088396735140/

[h1]DLC Progress[/h1]
We are still fixing Multiplayer bugs with Flatline where thankful survivors offering support match the smartphones directions (currently more than one area is active but should be fixed soon), some navigation issues, and a crash bug we're tracking down.

Character's are all done but having to link voices correctly which is being worked on now and will release shortly

[h1]Misc.[/h1]
We're working on a large Escape map with a focus on both indoor and outdoor exploration and objectives is coming along fantastically and will include many other game-modes likely with flatline as well.

We will be focusing after the release of our remaining DLC on noted bugs by team and community as well as improved Matchmaking, Lobby System, New Animation System with over 500 new animations, New Zombies including some uniques that are being tested (unique like Riot Zombies but a bit more terrifying), and for all including Linux/Mac users we still have plans with Valve to visit and discuss possible move to new/updated Engine for support of the above mentioned platforms and other improvements.

We are working on a PR schedule with our new PR Lead Bastian who will try to keep everyone better informed and in the loop with media and more as it's been difficulty to set aside time for posting announcements and don't want you all thinking we're not hard at work. We have a ridiculous amount of new content being created daily and will be released in the near future but it's always nice to see what is going on. Bastian is best known for artwork for loading screens and our teasers, trailers, and other video work.

We are always grateful to the Emails and Messages from the community showing their support and the incredible patience you've shown us. Thank you!

-The Contagion Team

notes.content:

Here is our second attempt at releasing the new weapons for those who missed the previous update we had to pull due to game breaking bug. Basically the DLLs required a special signature that when generated on a new machine was rejected and had to be done differently even with the documentation contradicting this. 

We apologize for the delay but so long as no serious bugs crop up we should be good to release more content soon such as Flatline and New Characters. notes.title: Contagion - Summer Sale, DLC Release, and Intel Showcase!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/2015_Contagion_Summer_Sale.jpg[/img][/url]

As everyone knows by now Steam is having it's yearly Summer Sale and they've got quite a bit of entertainment for us as well as some very sweet deals so do not miss out!

Contagion is on sale as well as the 4-Pack at 50% Off So check it out and share with your friends!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/Contagion_DLC.jpg[/img][/url]

But let's get to the real news regarding Contagion and that would be our Free DLC Bundle. After a poorly timed fiasco last year we've had to rebuild our team and learn from scratch quite a bit of work (please read our pinned thread on the details). This has delayed major releases including our Free DLC Bundle but we're tired of waiting and tired of making you guys wait.

While much of our content is linked due to the overhaul of the Source Engine and optimization as well as improved audio with Wwise we've managed to split the release into a few parts and will be delivering them asap starting today with our Map Release!

3 Gigabytes of Contagion Assets are currently being uploaded to Steam and in a few hours your copy of Contagion is going to either automatically start updating or ask that you update. We've been very busy even during the struggle that started last year and we believe modders will appreciate the ludicrous amount of content to work with and veteran players will notice significant improvements to existing environments. But today's release is focused on our MAP RELEASE with the below maps.

(We will be having all Official Servers Updated tomorrow)

https://youtu.be/NkpYVQGyWu0

[h1]Contagion DLC :: Map Release[/h1]

[b]CE_Harvest[/b]

[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/ce_harvest_preview.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/ce_harvest_preview_th.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]CE_CampWhitner :: CX_CampWhitner :: CH_CampWhitner[/b]

[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/ce_campwhitner_preview.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/ce_campwhitner_preview_th.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]CH_UnionStation[/b]

[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/ch_unionstation_preview.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/ch_unionstation_preview_th.jpg[/img][/url]

We will be releasing the new weapons, characters, and the new game-mode flatline as soon as these are ready or at least not as clumsy as they feel right now. The maps we've been having a blast on today making them release ready and will be reading your input as you play them. Modders will have much more content to work with and older maps have received some major polishing. Because there was soooo much work being done, so many devs being vetted, and confusion late last year and early this year there is no way to go over all the changes unfortunately but many veterans will notice the changes immediately to all existing content.

[url=https://appshowcase.intel.com/en-us/node/9188/revisions/11986][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/Intel_Logo_620.png[/img][/url]

Also wanted to share that we were invited and put on the Intel Showcase and have some other exciting news we hope we can share in the near future. That said, keep checking back on the next DLC release!

Someone asked us why we would waste our DLC during a Sale and lose the value behind marketing it. We told em we couldn't stand making you wait and that was costing us more.

Want to thank everyone for being so incredibly supportive and patient as we got our house in order. Looking forward to releasing content on a more regular basis once again.

-The Contagion Team

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/steam.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.facebook.com/contagion.game][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/facebook.png[/img][/url] [url=https://twitter.com/contagion_game][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/twitter.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.youtube.com/PlayContagion][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/youtube.png[/img][/url] [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/contagion][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/indiedb.png[/img][/url]

notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-18_ContagiousGaming04/contagious_gaming_preview_620.jpg[/img][/url]

Sorry for the delay guys but today we've made some serious progress and that is both good and bad for today's Stream! Due to the work we're doing I've got Alex working with the team to continue our progress and he will not be joining us on today's Stream. I'll also be starting the Stream late... clearly. Today's Stream & Giveaway will not be of Contagion as that's in development atm and we don't have the numbers to stream it properly nor do I want to halt the momentum. We will be playing "Hand of Fate" which a friend and fan thought you might enjoy and he will be joining Skype to read comments and follow the game real-time as it is Single-Player.

Just a quick progress update-
[list]
[*] All maps are ready
[*] All weapons are ready
[*] All characters are ready with some slight issue with voices but being fixed
[*] Flatline has 2 known issues. Weapon and Zombie spawns but we believe we caught the issue and hope to provide more info soon. Too many bugs cropped up during the overhaul of code but our new Programmer has been working very hard to solve this. The entire team have been pounding out quality work daily and that includes weekends.
[/list]

[h1]Contagious Gaming Game This Week[/h1]

Hand of Fate

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/266510/][img]http://www.darkstation.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/hof_xb1_01-620x350.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-18_ContagiousGaming04/contagious_gaming_preview_620.jpg[/img][/url]

Sorry for the delay guys but today we've made some serious progress and that is both good and bad for today's Stream! Due to the work we're doing I've got Alex working with the team to continue our progress and he will not be joining us on today's Stream. I'll also be starting the Stream late... clearly. Today's Stream & Giveaway will not be of Contagion as that's in development atm and we don't have the numbers to stream it properly nor do I want to halt the momentum. We will be playing "Hand of Fate" which a friend and fan thought you might enjoy and he will be joining Skype to read comments and follow the game real-time as it is Single-Player.

Just a quick progress update-
[list]
[*] All maps are ready
[*] All weapons are ready
[*] All characters are ready with some slight issue with voices but being fixed
[*] Flatline has 2 known issues. Weapon and Zombie spawns but we believe we caught the issue and hope to provide more info soon. Too many bugs cropped up during the overhaul of code but our new Programmer has been working very hard to solve this. The entire team have been pounding out quality work daily and that includes weekends.
[/list]

[h1]Contagious Gaming Game This Week[/h1]

Hand of Fate

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/266510/][img]http://www.darkstation.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/hof_xb1_01-620x350.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2013_09_13_Kickstarter/TwitchTV_450.png[/img][/url]

We stream our Official Contagion "Friday Frenzy" and/or "Contagious Gaming" via our Twitch.Tv Account at- http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0 every Friday @ 5:00PM PST/PDT but will be Streaming today at 6:30PM (GMT- 8:00) [url=http://wwp.greenwichmeantime.com/time-zone/usa/pacific-time/]-Click here for current time-[/url] and will pass out one or more free copies of Contagion during the Stream!

Hand of Fate looks to be a mix of say... Magic the Gathering meets Fable meets awesome Dungeon Crawler. Looking forward to getting in some game time with all of you! More excited for the update I'll receive tonight now that I'm waiting for the next batch to get working on. More updates on DLC soon!

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - DLC Status & Spring Sale
notes.content:
[url=https://www.humblebundle.com/store/p/contagion_storefront][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-09-04_HumbleStoreLaunch/Humble_Store_Launch_Preview.png[/img][/url]

April looked good for release but ran into issues with Wwise, a crash to desktop bug that eluded us, and issues with compound bow. Right now we've sorted the crash and wwise issue, compound bow is looking good, but now we're having an issue with the old spawning system and flatline but again this should be a simple fix.

We are hoping to get it out next week (earlier if possible) but won't promise again as I feel like I jinxed it with the April promise. We will also be pushing out content, bug fixes, and features soon after. Also we were listening when you guys asked for proof of work being done and the need to see what it is we're putting out so take a look at the teaser below!

[H1]Free DLC Teaser Trailer[/H1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NkpYVQGyWu0

[H1]Humble Bundle Spring Sale[/H1]

Currently 50% off with [u]possible[/u] featured discounts

We opted to join in on the Spring Sale this year but we have run into delays with the free DLC release so please don't purchase it for the sake of DLC release as it doesn't control random events. That being said DLC WILL be released asap.

Check out the spring sale and share with your friends!

Please be sure to visit - http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/618456760257254915/ for DLC Status Updates.

Also due to the work being done we won't be running a Stream & Giveaway today as I'd have to alt-tab quite often and cut out possibly for extended periods of testing and sometimes fixing some work.

notes.content:

We're nearly there with most of the work done and even managed to polish up a few things we didn't think we'd have time to.

[H1]DLC Status as of 04/25/2015[/H1]
[list]
[*] 12 Char select is done
[*] 4 new characters are in game and all Voice Actor's lines
[*] 4 weapons in game and awesome
[*] 2 maps looking gorgeous and more coming very very soon
[*] Flatline definitely has us excited and we hope you guys love it
[/list]

Will be working on the features, bugfixes, polish, and Linux/Mac support as soon as we can step back and work on upgrading to an updated version of Source!

[H1]2 Days left to send Contagion to E3[/H1]

Want to help us speed up the process and obtain more support? Send us Indies to E3 and get the PR and support needed to keep the momentum going!

It's simple. Just click on the link below and support Monochrome and then play the web based mini game like an RPG grapping upgrades first (relying on the automatons won't cut it ;_;) and we already know many are using auto clickers so don't be disheartened we still have a good shot if just a few of you are able to dedicate some free time this weekend but don't stress it as we will keep pushing with or without the visit to E3!

notes.title: Contagion - Free DLC Update Status and more!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-04-22_DLC_Status/Free_DLC_Status_Header.png[/img][/url]

I want to first thank everyone for their patience and for those who are still wondering why it's taken as long as it has please review our General Discussion Pinned threads explaining much of the delays but not as in depth as I would like considering so many had to start from scratch without documented work to refer to which will not be an issue in the future.

[H1]Overview[/H1]
As many of you already know, Monochrome has repeatedly posted that all Contagion content including the larger DLC Bundles will be released free of charge for all those who own Contagion and that we're currently working on our first DLC bundle release.

For the sake of having a date set we are going to state April 30th, 2015 is our release date. We don't expect it to be delayed beyond this date (or I wouldn't have listed it) but will apologize in advance if any unforeseen circumstances (as it should be clear by now this isn't uncommon) were to push that date out a bit.

We are also requesting Valve schedule a Free Weekend with discount so that friends and family can experience the new content and potentially purchase it at a lower price.

[H1]What to expect from DLC[/H1]
[list]
[*]4 New Characters (includes their own unique voice actors)
[list]
[*] Mia
[*] Curtis
[*] Yumi
[*] Manuel
[/list]
[*]4 New Weapons
[list]
[*] Compound Bow (Actually trying to do some unique animations never done in source before but won't let it delay release if we can't sort it out before date)
[*] Remington 870
[*] M1 Garand
[*] SCAR
[/list]
[*] 2 New Maps
[list]
[*] Union Station
[*] Harvest
[/list]
[*] 1 New Game-Mode
[list]
[*] Flatline (Prefix CF_) which is a waved based survival game mode that will focus heavily on watching each others back, gathering resources, unlocking new areas, and saving your fellow survivors after they've been severely injured and will be the first game-mode we've released where there is no player zombies in the design.
[/list]
[/list]

[H1]Where we are on the status of each asset/mode[/H1]
[list]
[*] Characters
[list]
[*] All Characters are in-game each with their own unique voice actor and personality with the exception of Curtis who we are still working on voice for.
[/list]
[*] Weapons
[list]
[*] All 4 weapons are complete, in-game, with unique sounds and animations
[/list]
[*] Maps
[list]
[*] Both maps are complete with extensive playtesting but Union Station is being modified as we polish up Flatline.
[/list]
[*] Game-Mode
[list]
[*] Flatline is coming along nicely but we're still adjusting for balancing and testing as we didn't want to just fling a simple survival mode in there which can already be done by modders in other game-modes.
[/list]
[/list]

[H1]How confident are we about release[/H1]
We're actually quite confident but know if we run into an issue like we did with animations and how they were originally setup and the research time it took to sort out and implement the updated ones which we don't expect to happen but when including new content a lot of people are involved and the tinniest mistake can lead to delays. That said if I wasn't comfortable with April I wouldn't have stated that's the release month and now we have a day (if we release earlier... yay?).

[H1]What about the existing bugs and less than user friendly features?[/H1]
Many bug fixes are already included in this release like the local co-op cockroach glitch and we will definitely be implementing and polishing up new and existing features that will make playing Contagion easier and more enjoyable but many of these will be after this DLC Release.

[H1]What about Linux & Mac Platforms?[/H1]
We spent a great deal of money to make our version of the Engine Linux/Mac friendly but hit brickwall after brickwall even with the most experienced of programmers which is what happened with Valve and so while we can't release it on these platforms now we fully intend to put all our effort into moving to an updated version of Source (who knows what our options may be at that point) when it won't affect the majority of players. We have not forgotten our pledge to support these platforms.

[H1]Oh and btw...[/H1]
We already have a large map currently labelled camp that is nearly release ready for Escape, Extraction, and Hunted and another in the works. This map will expand on what we attempted to do in the past by including a unique story and possibly leading to something bigger for Contagion fans!

[H1]But you forgot...[/H1]
Sorry if I missed anything but it's likely already addressed in the Official Steam Contagion Community Hub so be sure to check it out and do a search if you don't see your question answered here.

[H1]OH DON'T FORGET TO SEND CONTAGION TO E3![/H1]
We could not delay the DLC by having our Team earn points for the Indie Crash E3 promo but by supporting and playing a slightly addictive web based game you can earn points for us to bring Contagion to E3 and increase our exposure which benefits the team and the community! Some members have well over 2billion points which means they alone are 1/15th of our total points and we're in the top 20 and going up in rank. If we had a handful of users do the same we would hit top 5 easy.

WANT TO HELP? THEN CLICK THE IMAGE BELOW AND SUPPORT US!
[url=http://indiescrashe3.com/nomination/21D2E0A6-6D1E-22E7-AD7C-DAFBBB068094][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/22/21237/thumb_620x2000/e3.jpg[/img][/url]

or click here - http://indiescrashe3.com/nomination/21D2E0A6-6D1E-22E7-AD7C-DAFBBB068094

ONLY 4-3 DAYS LEFT TO SHOW YOUR SUPPORT! Which is honestly with the help of a small small small percentage of our active community members more than enough time to get us there!

Want to once again thank everyone for all you've done for us over the years and we are still trying to repay the favor! Sorry it's taking us so long but we won't stop working away at making Contagion one of your favorite titles.

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Support Contagion & Nominate us for E3!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/22/21237/thumb_620x2000/e3.jpg[/img][/url]

I know you're all eagerly awaiting an update on our April Free DLC release but for now I can only say that we "may" be bundling in a 3rd Escape/Extraction/Hunted Map (it was built specifically for all 3 but Escape shines!).

We and many other Indies have been asked to attend E3 but we've been putting ALL of this years sales into Contagion though we will be saving up for PAX Prime late this year as well as that was planned. The thing is you guys can help get Contagion out there as they will be picking 5 Indies to come out and with our Free DLC, new content, new features, and of course improvements & fixes we want to make sure to fill up our servers as well as the 1000 we have on reserve for just such a time.

If you would like to Support Contagion and it's community all you need to do is visit - http://indiescrashe3.com/nomination/21D2E0A6-6D1E-22E7-AD7C-DAFBBB068094 and click Support!

Now to get back to getting this content out!

[h1]Quick Break-down[/h1]
[list]
[*] Weapons are finished and in game (animations are being polished a bit)
[*] Characters are finished and in game (finalizing temp character select for 12 character's until we add in the new lobby system after this release which will allow friends to easily create/join servers for private or public games and have the our Voice Actor's finishing up additional lines)
[*] Maps are finished and playable (working out a few kinks with new game-mode Flatline so you're not all disappointed)
[*] New Game-Mode Flatline (Survival) is as described above being worked on to avoid disappointment but is looking promising
[*] As we said we may actually end up adding in a new map (Escape/Extraction/Hunted with focus on Escape story wise) but if not will be released shortly after!
[/list]

[h1]NO STREAM FRIDAY[/h1]
As I will be visiting my nieces and nephew and getting back Sunday before our big DLC meeting I won't be able to run a Stream today. I've spoken to the team and all is still coming along as planned and this will not delay anything regarding our Free DLC April release. Just wanted to give a heads up to those who are likely to ask about it.

Sorry I've been so busy this month but with Immigration, Setup in New Home, and seeing my mom after 8 years I've been doing my best! I can promise you that none of this is delaying the release of DLC just communication between the Team and Community which I will be working on improving once again! Your long awaited DLC is on the way!

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Heading to GDC 2015 and why?!
notes.content:
[url=http://www.gdconf.com/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-02-28_GDC2015/GDC_2015_Banner.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Monochrome on our way to GDC 2015[/h1]
In roughly 12 hours I (Brian "Tatsur0") will be on my way to the airport to fly to San Francisco, CA for this years Game Developer's Conference where I will join up with Alex "Swolfington" & Joseph "SickJoe" to meet with friends, colleagues, publishers, and more!

[h1]But why GDC?[/h1]
GDC is great for Developers and those seeking them. Quite a lot of business gets done and the simple answer is we're going out there to further secure the future of Monochrome which in includes Contagion!

[h1]Any other reason?[/h1]
In fact there is another. We are excited to be sitting down with some big names regarding our next game we've been hinting at "Project Ageless". This game is inspired by the classics and today's geniuses and will be a Sci-Fi Horror title that should shake things up! If all goes well we should be able to release a bit more publicly during/after the conference!

[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-02-28_GDC2015/Project_Ageless_Logo.png[/img]

[h1]Wait... What about Contagion?![/h1]
Do not fret!!! We have an incredible team who are working in sync with one another and soon not only will we be releasing the DLC (once we return will be discussing a release date with the team and hopefully announcing it which will put me in the awkward position of making a promise and you should know by now I hate those) but also new maps, weapons, features such as improved matchmaking, lobby system, animation system, AI, melee, and much more... yes that includes our goal to release on Mac & Linux still knowing it's going to be a hard and long road but anyone that knows me from the Quake/GoldSrc/Source days knows I'm stubborn and am not one to quit easily. There is no reason to be concerned!

I hope you all are as excited as we are and will wish us luck on our vaca....business trip and if you happen to be at the Conference be sure to let us know by Emailing contact(at)monochrome-games(dot)com!


-The Contagion Team

Sorry we're late but we ended up screwing things up to setup this special DLC "Friday Frenzy" teaser Stream! We don't want to give everything away but in the process we had to start sorta from scratch to fix some code issues but don't worry backed up where we left off so nothing lost just delayed.

I want to thank Alex & Robert Gatson and everyone for working very hard today to help us resolve the issues.

Once again we're sorry for the delay and even though you won't get to see everything we will be showing you some sweet new DLC and giving out Contagion Keys!

[h1]Free DLC Bundle[/h1]
Check out what's to come soon!

[h1]4 New Characters[/h1]
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Free_DLC_Character_Preview.jpg[/img]

[h1]4 New Weapons[/h1]
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Free_DLC_Weapon_Preview.jpg[/img]

[h1]2 New Maps[/h1]
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Free_DLC_Map_Preview.jpg[/img]

[h1]1 New Game-Mode[/h1]
[b]CF_ (Flatline Game-Mode)[/b] is a cooperative survival wave-based mode where your goal is to survive as long as possible (with a potential final fight). Unlike the other game modes, you do not return as a zombie when you die. When you get got, you end up in a unique "Medical Triage" location that zombies can only enter if all players perish, thus losing the round. However as long as there is one 1 living survivor at the end of a wave, all players will spawn outside the Triage and can then prepare for the next wave. Each successive wave becomes more and more difficult, and as waves come to pass, access to new area opens up. This gives the horde new ways to reach you, as well as a  chance to rescue AI survivors (they must survive the wave as well!) who will provide a cache of helpful items for the upcoming wave. Ultimately we are still striving for a unique game each and every time without any predictable patterns or spawns while also allowing for the environments to change as well.

See you soon!

-The Contagion Team
