notes.title: Contagion - The Story, Finally PROGRESS, DLC Media & Info, and much more!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/Contagion_Store_Announcement_Preview.png[/img]
Many of you have been frustrated by the recent string of delays; not only for the DLC, but for seemingly simple bug fixes, and for other miscellaneous updates. We understand this is especially frustrating since in the past we had been putting out updates bi-weekly (some with significant changes!), and for this we sincerely apologize. With things finally back on track we felt it important to be a bit more transparent, and to that end we will shed some light on the reasons behind the delays and as well as share details on future updates (WHICH ARE STILL FREE TO ALL THOSE WHO OWN CONTAGION!). We are excited for the coming weeks and months and you should be too!

[h1]The Story[/h1]
In case anyone is unfamiliar, the last update for the game was on October 10th, while our first Free DLC Bundle was planned for a Q4 2014 release. Unfortunately, behind the scenes we were dealing with a severe breakdown in communication and morale, fueled largely by exhaustion. 

We're not a large team, and no one wishes to express their frustration or admit feeling burned-out to friends and this is especially true when their friend is also their "boss". When these situations arise they tend to boil-over quickly, so when a well loved member of the team abruptly left to pursue other interests, we had a bit of an avalanche effect. By the end of the week we lost half our team, including Dec Doyle, our Lead and only programmer at the time. While losing Dec did set us back, I have to add that he did an exceptional job of sticking around to make sure ZombieFest went off without a hitch and is still a well respected and loved friend. Shortly after that, one of the partners and our only Composer & Sound Designer departed.

Fortunately, experience has taught us to be prepared and so we had the resources to replace many of the vacant positions, with the exception of a reliable Programmer and Composer & Sound Designer though the latter not being as urgent as we had most of the sound work completed. Frustratingly this was not the case for programmer position, and as luck would have it we ended up spending months bleeding money, hiring several individuals in a row who did not work out. It was at this point that our luck started to turn around, and we came into contact with Robert Gatson, a 20+ year Industry veteran. With a great knowledge of software development, designing Engines, excellent team building skills, and a strong interest in our current and future titles, he was/is a perfect fit.

With everything looking as good as it does, I'd love to give you a date for the Free DLC Bundle. In the spirit of not creating any more false hopes however, we can't give a solid date. We can say that we have every intention and reason to believe it will be out before the end of February. Following the DLC, we fully expect to be able to pump out bug fixes and updates at the pace many of you have come to enjoy in the past.

While Both Alex and I take full responsibility for having let you guys down, I can't express how happy we are to have the team we currently have, and especially to the community who has believed in us and showed us great patience. Thank you all, and hope you all will forgive us and join us as we move forward!

[h1]Free DLC Bundle[/h1]
While we're very confident with February some of you have been eagerly waiting for a good while and so we'd like to share with you some media that is intentional set at 620 width so that you can truly appreciate it more so in-game. We have so much to show you that we wouldn't to fit in on a dozen posts but hope you appreciate this little bit!

[h1]4 New Characters[/h1]
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Free_DLC_Character_Preview.jpg[/img]

[h1]4 New Weapons[/h1]
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Free_DLC_Weapon_Preview.jpg[/img]

[h1]2 New Maps[/h1]
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Free_DLC_Map_Preview.jpg[/img]

[h1]1 New Game-Mode[/h1]
[b]CF_ (Flatline Game-Mode) is a cooperative survival wave-based mode where your goal is to survive as long as possible (with a potential final fight). Unlike the other game modes, you do not return as a zombie when you die. When you get got, you end up in a unique "Medical Triage" location that zombies can only enter if all players perish, thus losing the round. However as long as there is one 1 living survivor at the end of a wave, all players will spawn outside the Triage and can then prepare for the next wave. Each successive wave becomes more and more difficult, and as waves come to pass, access to new area opens up. This gives the horde new ways to reach you, as well as a  chance to rescue AI survivors (they must survive the wave as well!) who will provide a cache of helpful items for the upcoming wave. Ultimately we are still striving for a unique game each and every time without any predictable patterns or spawns while also allowing for the environments to change as well.

[h1]Additional Media[/h1]
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Contagion_Assets_Preview.png[/img]

[h1]Some other things to prepare for[/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/620703493330724727/

-The Contagion Team
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430]Contagion - Steam Store[/url]
[url=https://www.humblebundle.com/store/p/contagion_storefront]Contagion - Humble Bundle Store[/url]

notes.title: Official Contagion - Winter Holiday Stream & Giveaway! 12 of the Most Wanted Games!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-12-25_Christmas/Contagion_Steam_Winter_Featured_Sale.jpg[/img][/url]

We are pleasantly surprised to see that we got featured on Christmas Day! We've handed out a number of Steam Gift Cards this month to friends and family and hope to see many purchasing the significantly discounted price of the 4-Pack but our bigger announcement is below!

We'd like to thank all of our faithful followers and the Contagion Community for all the support you've shown us throughout 2014 and for many long before we ever released!

We would not be here without all of you and we're consistently working towards a more enjoyable and well rounded experience with Contagion as we've promised. We've been able to invest most of the years earnings back into the Company both to finalize Contagion as we've discussed including the Lobby System for joining servers with your friends, A sense of progression while playing, New Achievements, our upcoming Free DLC Bundles (which each include 4 New Characters, 4 New Weapons, 2 New Maps, and a New Game-Mode), and more but also to work on our NextGen title currently code-named "Project Ageless" which I will say now is not delaying any work on Contagion whatsoever!

I am unfortunately alone these Holidays as I wait for Immigration to get their act together and allow my Wife, 2 Daughters, and Son to enter the US and so I wish to spend today (Christmas for many/A Holiday for others) with my friends and so many of you I hope to meet one day at one of our Expo's and/or Events!

While the rest of the team has scheduled their day to fit in work today on Contagion some may find time to join me in a 12 Game Stream & Giveaway to celebrate our Success thanks to all of you and our future as well as today of all days! The guys are hard at work on the upcoming Free DLC (Release Date will be Announced soon and I'll likely leak the intended date during the Stream a couple times... need more egg nog) so I will not pull any who are hard at work but all are welcome to join me and take a break (remember they were not asked to work today!).

[h1]2014 Winter Holiday Stream & Giveaway Games[/h1]

Today we will be giving away 12 games via raffle after each presentation/playthrough on our Stream at http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0 and those games are presented below. To be eligible to win you must be a follower of our Twitch Channel and be ready for the raffle!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-12-25_Christmas/Contagion_Steam_Winter_Featured_Sale.jpg[/img][/url]

We are pleasantly surprised to see that we got featured on Christmas Day! We've handed out a number of Steam Gift Cards this month to friends and family and hope to see many purchasing the significantly discounted price of the 4-Pack but our bigger announcement is below!

We'd like to thank all of our faithful followers and the Contagion Community for all the support you've shown us throughout 2014 and for many long before we ever released!

We would not be here without all of you and we're consistently working towards a more enjoyable and well rounded experience with Contagion as we've promised. We've been able to invest most of the years earnings back into the Company both to finalize Contagion as we've discussed including the Lobby System for joining servers with your friends, A sense of progression while playing, New Achievements, our upcoming Free DLC Bundles (which each include 4 New Characters, 4 New Weapons, 2 New Maps, and a New Game-Mode), and more but also to work on our NextGen title currently code-named "Project Ageless" which I will say now is not delaying any work on Contagion whatsoever!

I am unfortunately alone these Holidays as I wait for Immigration to get their act together and allow my Wife, 2 Daughters, and Son to enter the US and so I wish to spend today (Christmas for many/A Holiday for others) with my friends and so many of you I hope to meet one day at one of our Expo's and/or Events!

While the rest of the team has scheduled their day to fit in work today on Contagion some may find time to join me in a 12 Game Stream & Giveaway to celebrate our Success thanks to all of you and our future as well as today of all days! The guys are hard at work on the upcoming Free DLC (Release Date will be Announced soon and I'll likely leak the intended date during the Stream a couple times... need more egg nog) so I will not pull any who are hard at work but all are welcome to join me and take a break (remember they were not asked to work today!).

[h1]2014 Winter Holiday Stream & Giveaway Games[/h1]

Today we will be giving away 12 games via raffle after each presentation/playthrough on our Stream at http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0 and those games are presented below. To be eligible to win you must be a follower of our Twitch Channel and be ready for the raffle!

All 12 Games are being prepared and so this is just a heads up that we will be playing these games later today and handing out a free copy! We will announce the time soon! Hoping to start the stream in about an hour!

notes.title: Contagion - Autumn Sale, Free DLC Bundle, Upcoming Features, and More!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-11-26_AutumnSale/Contagion_Autumn_Sale_2014.jpg[/img][/url]

It's nearly Thanksgiving for many and even if you're not celebrating (in my case my family is still in Japan until immigration gives the go ahead) we still have the Steam Autumn Sale to enjoy! There are a number of great titles especially Indies on sale so don't miss out!

We have more to celebrate as we're much closer to the release of our first FREE DLC Bundle having hired more talent to speed up development (we've been stubborn about releasing quality updates and making sure our DLC is well worth the wait) of the 4 new Characters, 4 new Weapons, 2 New Maps, and our New Game-Mode Flatline with Union Station being the first of many Flatline maps. In addition to the DLC we are working on some very important features to improve the overall experience of Contagion all of which we're hoping to release before the end of the year! Here's a preview of what's to come-

[h1]Contagion - Free DLC Bundle Preview[/h1]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-11-26_AutumnSale/Contagion_DLC_Survivor_Preview.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-11-26_AutumnSale/Contagion_DLC_Survivor_Preview_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-11-26_AutumnSale/Contagion_DLC_M1G_Preview.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-11-26_AutumnSale/Contagion_DLC_M1G_Preview_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-11-26_AutumnSale/Contagion_DLC_CE_Harvest_Preview.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-11-26_AutumnSale/Contagion_DLC_CE_Harvest_Preview_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-11-26_AutumnSale/Contagion_DLC_CF_UnionStation_Preview.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-11-26_AutumnSale/Contagion_DLC_CF_UnionStation_Preview_th.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Contagion - Upcoming Feature List[/h1]
[list]
[*] Lobby System - No more struggling to host a game with friends. Create and edit a lobby for you and your friends to experience Contagion how you prefer to play
[*] Improved Animation System - Utilizing our new mocap animations fully to bring a more immersive experience to your games
[*] Ranking & Unlockables - As you play our Co-op on Official Servers you will be able to obtain rewards to customize weapons and rank up
[*] Improved Shader System to take advantage of shaders not yet included as well as optimize our existing setup so lower end systems can enjoy some of the shaders they were unable to till now
[/list]

With another Free DLC Bundle designed and ready to be worked on we will see more Escape, Extraction, Flatline maps as well as numerous bug fixes and optimization. There are also plans to update Contagion's Engine to support Mac & Linux builds as promised. Also worth noting that we're working on a big reveal for GDC 2015 for those attending or keeping tabs on GDC and/or Contagion!

[h1]Holiday Live Stream & Giveaway[/h1]
[url=http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2013_09_13_Kickstarter/TwitchTV_450.png[/img][/url]

We stream our Official Contagion "Friday Frenzy" and/or "Contagious Gaming" via our Twitch.Tv Account at- http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0 every Friday @ 5:00PM PST/PDT (GMT- 8:00) [url=http://wwp.greenwichmeantime.com/time-zone/usa/pacific-time/]-Click here for current time-[/url] and will pass out one or more free copies of Contagion during the Stream!

We will be Streaming Live this Friday a number of titles on Sale and doing our Holiday Giveaway of said titles during our Friday "Contagious Gaming" Live Stream & Giveaway at 5:00PM PST (GMT - 8:00) via http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0

Contagion is now on Sale at $9.99 or $29.99 for a 4-Pack
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/site_images/contagion-now-on-steam.png[/img][/url]

Working with Valve we've made sure to avoid mistakes with this holiday sale so you will notice that our 4-Pack is also on sale and apologize for the Halloween Hiccup we were unable to resolve in time.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2013-11-28_Thanksgiving/thanksgiving_footer.png[/img][/url]

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Sept 14th Update :: Significant Improvements, Update on Linux/Mac, and More
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/Contagion_Store_Announcement_Preview.png[/img][/url]

Today's update may seem smaller than it really is which has more to do with a great deal of work than the lack there of. Since our July 31st/August 1st release our focus has been on the Free 1st DLC Bundle and the Core Game Mechanics much of which is still being prototyped and tested for upcoming releases.

There hasn't been a single day of inactivity and we may have some additional surprises coming your way. Even with me flying back home to the States to save the Company additional expenses and get me on a timezone to better run things with Alex Wright (COO) I already have a powerful NoteBook to continue my work and everyone knows what they're do. I will also be making my first public appearance via a popular Talk Show on October 10th, Sponsoring and Running a Large Venue with 32 high end machines in the center of ZombieFest (with possible special guest appearance), and I think we might hit up Universal and/or DisneyWorld (never been to Florida) the day before we return.

Our Changelog is missing a considerable amount of AI Code, Optimization to Code, and further steps towards including the features we've mentioned such as an improved and much needed lobby system for those not wanting to go through the trouble of setting up a server which requires the usual Port Forwarding and more or 3rd Party Lan related software, New Animation System for our MoCap Animations, Ranking, Unlockables, Stats, and cosmetic options for players.

I will not see my family for some time as we sort Immigration which means I will be lost in my work. This year is going to be a very exciting year!

Check out today's Update (Including additions that didn't make it in the Build Changelog Text)-

[H1]Contagion - Update September 14th Changelog:[/H1]
[list]
[*] Added new triggers and challenges to Biotec
[*] Added new gates to CE_StoneCreek
[*] Added new sounds to improve atmosphere and immersion
[*] Improved Sound Zones
[*] Optimized AI Code
[*] Optimized Core Engine to boost Performance
[*] Optimized a significant number of assets to improve quality of game-play
[*] Optimized the following maps. CE_RoanokePD, CE_Biotec, CE_StoneCreek, and CE_BarloweSquare
[*] Significantly improved Zombie Pathing & Nav Mesh in CE_RoanokePD, 
CE_Biotec, CE_StoneCreek, and CE_BarloweSquare
[*] Removed dozens of Bugs, Exploits, and Glitches in CE_RoanokePD, 
CE_Biotec, CE_StoneCreek, and CE_BarloweSquare
[*] Removed obsolete Sounds and other Assets
[*] Rebuilt numerous Biotec and BarloweSquare Props to avoid issues with 
Players & AI
[*] Fixed a number of scripts for more accurate and improved game-play
[/list]

More updates coming and without the major delays!

Very soon we will be leaking more about the upcoming Free DLC as you may have caught some of that in the past. All 4 weapons are nearing release status, All 4 new characters are looking great (Manuel, Yumi, Mia, & Curtis), Both Maps again right on track, and Flatline is looking very promising. There are rumors of a release date and originally was planned for 3rd quarter but too many deaths, babies, and overhauls have led to delays. We have no doubt that we'll release before years end only our 1st Free DLC Bundle and we promised 2 but while we have an internal date we do not have a public ETA just yet.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-06-16_Update_Splitscreen/linux_mac_icon.png[/img][/url] I've mentioned this before but the Engine we're currently on has led to numerous brick walls when trying to do as something as simple as creating working Linux Binaries let alone Linux & Mac Platforms. It wasn't built for it but we have a few tricks up our sleeve to try and sort this out. If for any reason this does not pan out our only option is to update to a later Engine which considering the fact we gutted the original for the most part is not an easy task.

We are currently interviewing some of the best and brightest to either work it out or take up Valve's suggestion to move to a new Engine which will require some delicate coordination so that we can still update the existing Engine while building up on the new. No matter what happens our goal is to keep our promise and release on both Linux & Mac. We owe it to our fans but more importantly to those who made sure we hit that Stretch Goal! I rarely make promises so I never have to break em and I don't plan to break this one.

We highly recommend Linux and Mac users NOT purchase Contagion until this is sorted unless you're comfortable with Wine or Crossover.

Again I am flying back home and this will require a lot of effort to get setup with me passing my work to the team but not being as available as I've been with the community (I will do whatever I can to sort this out ASAP and maybe sooner than I expect). This includes our Weekly "Friday Frenzy" Twitch Stream & Giveaway. Some good news on that front is we've got an eager member of the team working out a SFM intro with a new music track specifically made for it when it will most definitely start back up and may even return with DLC in mind! For now please enjoy the latest Episode 31 (check out any else you missed as well as Contagious Gaming Playlist)!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=49UHj7P1jUk

Expect a pretty epic year! Wish me a safe flight(s) and remember just cause I may not be around for a bit the team is still working day & night and your support has always kept us moving steadily forward!

-The Contagion Team

Even with me flying back home to the States to save the Company additional expenses and get me on a timezone to better run things with Alex Wright (COO) I already have a powerful NoteBook to continue my work and everyone knows what they're do. I will also be making my first public appearance via a popular Talk Show on October 10th, Sponsoring and Running a Large Venue with 32 high end machines in the center of ZombieFest (with possible special guest appearance), and I think we might hit up Universal and/or DisneyWorld (never been to Florida) the day before we return.

Our Changelog is missing a considerable amount of AI Code, Optimization to Code, and further steps towards including the features we've mentioned such as an improved and much needed lobby system for those not wanting to go through the trouble of setting up a server which requires the usual Port Forwarding and more or 3rd Party Lan related software, New Animation System for our MoCap Animations, Ranking, Unlockables, Stats, and cosmetic options for players.

I will not see my family for some time as we sort Immigration which means I will be lost in my work. This year is going to be a very exciting year!

Check out today's Update (Including additions that didn't make it in the Build Changelog Text)-

[H1]Contagion - Update September 14th Changelog:[/H1]
[list]
[*] Added new triggers and challenges to Biotec
[*] Added new gates to CE_StoneCreek
[*] Added new sounds to improve atmosphere and immersion
[*] Improved Sound Zones
[*] Optimized AI Code
[*] Optimized Core Engine to boost Performance
[*] Optimized a significant number of assets to improve quality of game-play
[*] Optimized the following maps. CE_RoanokePD, CE_Biotec, CE_StoneCreek, and CE_BarloweSquare
[*] Significantly improved Zombie Pathing & Nav Mesh in CE_RoanokePD, 
CE_Biotec, CE_StoneCreek, and CE_BarloweSquare
[*] Removed dozens of Bugs, Exploits, and Glitches in CE_RoanokePD, 
CE_Biotec, CE_StoneCreek, and CE_BarloweSquare
[*] Removed obsolete Sounds and other Assets
[*] Rebuilt numerous Biotec and BarloweSquare Props to avoid issues with 
Players & AI
[*] Fixed a number of scripts for more accurate and improved game-play
[/list]

More updates coming and without the major delays!

Very soon we will be leaking more about the upcoming Free DLC as you may have caught some of that in the past. All 4 weapons are nearing release status, All 4 new characters are looking great (Manuel, Yumi, Mia, & Curtis), Both Maps again right on track, and Flatline is looking very promising. There are rumors of a release date and originally was planned for 3rd quarter but too many deaths, babies, and overhauls have led to delays. We have no doubt that we'll release before years end only our 1st Free DLC Bundle and we promised 2 but while we have an internal date we do not have a public ETA just yet.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-06-16_Update_Splitscreen/linux_mac_icon.png[/img][/url] I've mentioned this before but the Engine we're currently on has led to numerous brick walls when trying to do as something as simple as creating working Linux Binaries let alone Linux & Mac Platforms. It wasn't built for it but we have a few tricks up our sleeve to try and sort this out. If for any reason this does not pan out our only option is to update to a later Engine which considering the fact we gutted the original for the most part is not an easy task.

We are currently interviewing some of the best and brightest to either work it out or take up Valve's suggestion to move to a new Engine which will require some delicate coordination so that we can still update the existing Engine while building up on the new. No matter what happens our goal is to keep our promise and release on both Linux & Mac. We owe it to our fans but more importantly to those who made sure we hit that Stretch Goal! I rarely make promises so I never have to break em and I don't plan to break this one.

We highly recommend Linux and Mac users NOT purchase Contagion until this is sorted unless you're comfortable with Wine or Crossover.

Again I am flying back home and this will require a lot of effort to get setup with me passing my work to the team but not being as available as I've been with the community (I will do whatever I can to sort this out ASAP and maybe sooner than I expect). This includes our Weekly "Friday Frenzy" Twitch Stream & Giveaway. Some good news on that front is we've got an eager member of the team working out a SFM intro with a new music track specifically made for it when it will most definitely start back up and may even return with DLC in mind! For now please enjoy the latest Episode 31 (check out any else you missed as well as Contagious Gaming Playlist)!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=49UHj7P1jUk

Expect a pretty epic year! Wish me a safe flight(s) and remember just cause I may not be around for a bit the team is still working day & night and your support has always kept us moving steadily forward!

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - ZombieFest & "Break Down" WebComic :: Volume 3 Week 9
notes.content:
[url=https://www.downtownlakelandzombies.com/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-09-01_ZombieFest/Contagion_ZombieFest_Flier.jpg[/img][/url]

We our very passionate about our work and community and from reactions from Romero's "Finally", to the cast of The Walking Dead sharing interest via tweets, as well as major editors and youtubers showing support it would seem we're not the only ones and feel lucky to have reached so many.

Apparently we reached an entire city that shares our passion for Contagion when a member of the ZombieFest commity in Lakeland, Florida USA introduced themselves and their event and asked if we would be interested in using their Studio (center of the Event), setup our game at the Venue, and be their headline Sponsor as they work towards obtaining the Guinness World Record for having the most "Zombies" in one location which is looking promising with the numbers looking to beat out those in Jersey from last year.

Apparently the City from the Mayors Office to the Police Department (running security) are fans of Contagion which blew our minds and really wanted us to participate when our name came popping up for a Game Center. We've also got Universal Studio's painting people up as Zombies, ZombieFest & Contagion Digital Billboards, Signs on Buses, and more all over Florida (if you're out there, keep your eyes peeled!). 

All of Downtown Lakeland is participating and we're honored to be a part of it. They're even preparing a Cake (4'x3') for us and Most everyone from the team will be there as well a possible Special Guest! We'll also be doing a popular Talk Show (has been hinted there may be more than one) aired during Prime Time which we'll release more information regarding as we learn more but we do know we're recording on the 10th (so we'll be around from Oct 9th - Oct 14th with our Families but remember jet lag, 4am wake up for prep, and more. Doubt we'll need the make-up to pull off a decent zombie).

[url=https://www.downtownlakelandzombies.com/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-09-01_ZombieFest/Contagion_ZombieFest_Cake.jpg[/img][/url]

We're all very excited for the event but this has also locked us down in sorting out updates, hitting deadlines, and preparing the upcoming free DLC! 

We haven't forgotten our Official Weekly WebComic (SickJoe is just that. Sick and we love it! He'll also be attending ZombieFest for fans of his work and may want to learn more about the Future of Monochrome LLC) and so here is our latest update which was unfortunately delayed due to our Weekend promo that is now over and our bandwidth being torn to shreds by the Steam Community heh.

[h1]Official Contagion Comic - Chapter 3 :: Week 9[/h1]

[url=http://www.contagion-game.com/comicbook/][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/images/comicbook/chapters/contagion_breakdown_cover_620_preview.jpg[/img][/url]

We're looking into releasing our WebComic in a manageable format as well as our OST which will include our music from the game as well as our cinematic trailer! More surprises on the way and soon!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/site_images/contagion-now-on-steam.png[/img][/url]

We really want to meet up with our Fans in Florida so if you can be there on October 11th it'll be hard to miss us. Come on in and say hi, sit down at one of numerous computers and play Contagion! Looking to have some swag and signings of our Comic and more!

If you're new to Contagion but in the area and/or a Zombie enthusiast we still hope to see you there!

We our very passionate about our work and community and from reactions from Romero's "Finally", to the cast of The Walking Dead sharing interest via tweets, as well as major editors and youtubers showing support it would seem we're not the only ones and feel lucky to have reached so many.

Apparently we reached an entire city that shares our passion for Contagion when a member of the ZombieFest commity in Lakeland, Florida USA introduced themselves and their event and asked if we would be interested in using their Studio (center of the Event), setup our game at the Venue, and be their headline Sponsor as they work towards obtaining the Guinness World Record for having the most "Zombies" in one location which is looking promising with the numbers looking to beat out those in Jersey from last year.

Apparently the City from the Mayors Office to the Police Department (running security) are fans of Contagion which blew our minds and really wanted us to participate when our name came popping up for a Game Center. We've also got Universal Studio's painting people up as Zombies, ZombieFest & Contagion Digital Billboards, Signs on Buses, and more all over Florida (if you're out there, keep your eyes peeled!). 

All of Downtown Lakeland is participating and we're honored to be a part of it. They're even preparing a Cake (4'x3') for us and Most everyone from the team will be there as well a possible Special Guest! We'll also be doing a popular Talk Show (has been hinted there may be more than one) aired during Prime Time which we'll release more information regarding as we learn more but we do know we're recording on the 10th (so we'll be around from Oct 9th - Oct 14th with our Families but remember jet lag, 4am wake up for prep, and more. Doubt we'll need the make-up to pull off a decent zombie).

[url=https://www.downtownlakelandzombies.com/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-09-01_ZombieFest/Contagion_ZombieFest_Cake.jpg[/img][/url]

We're all very excited for the event but this has also locked us down in sorting out updates, hitting deadlines, and preparing the upcoming free DLC! 

We haven't forgotten our Official Weekly WebComic (SickJoe is just that. Sick and we love it! He'll also be attending ZombieFest for fans of his work and may want to learn more about the Future of Monochrome LLC) and so here is our latest update which was unfortunately delayed due to our Weekend promo that is now over and our bandwidth being torn to shreds by the Steam Community heh.

[h1]Official Contagion Comic - Chapter 3 :: Week 9[/h1]

[url=http://www.contagion-game.com/comicbook/][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/images/comicbook/chapters/contagion_breakdown_cover_620_preview.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.contagion-game.com/comicbook/][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/images/comicbook/previews/week21/cont_checking_out_wk21_steam.jpg[/img][/url]

We're looking into releasing our WebComic in a manageable format as well as our OST which will include our music from the game as well as our cinematic trailer! More surprises on the way and soon!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/site_images/contagion-now-on-steam.png[/img][/url]

We really want to meet up with our Fans in Florida so if you can be there on October 11th it'll be hard to miss us. Come on in and say hi, sit down at one of numerous computers and play Contagion! Looking to have some swag and signings of our Comic and more!

If you're new to Contagion but in the area and/or a Zombie enthusiast we still hope to see you there!

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Free Weekend & 75% Discount :: Try Before You Buy!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-08-28_FreeWeekend/Contagion_Store_Free_Weekend_Discount_Preview.jpg[/img][/url]

After some trouble with scheduling in the past we've finally scheduled with Valve our first Free Weekend with a 75% Discount of our first Indie title Contagion. We highly recommend that you play Contagion this weekend and if you've found a game that satisfies your Zombie Apocalypse fantasies and to quote Romero himself "Finally" hope you'll take advantage of our discount and be here for all that is to come, if not we would like to thank those who took the time to give our game a go and hope you'll follow our progress.

Many of our community already know what to expect with a dedicated team of developers who are putting out consistent updates, bug fixes, and listening to feedback that impacts future improvements. Will be continuing to release new content as well as our Free DLC Bundle's (2 are planned at this time) that include in each 4 New Characters, 4 New Weapons, 2 New Maps, and 1 New Game-Mode. 

Our updates are not limited to just content as we're moving forward with our new Mocap Animations on completion of our new layered animation system built from the ground up, further improvements to performance that is always changing our System Requirements, Ability to play with your friends via a Lobby system, Ranking, Stats, New Achievements, Customizable Cosmetics, and Unlockables for Co-op play.

For those new to Contagion and not yet up to speed via our Streams, Videos, Guides, and Forum Posts the following information may help! (PRESS F1 in-game to display your binds)

[h1]Contagion :: Game-Modes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Escape (CE_ Prefix)
[list]
[*]In Escape you can play up to 8 Survivors trying to escape the location and situation you've found yourself in. With each round objectives, paths, weapon & ammo spawns, as well as zombie spawns are randomly generated making each attempt/round unique from the rest. With the spawning system you can play 100 games that are different from the first. Be sure to follow the instructions and in many cases the distance meter on your smart phone to complete objectives.
[/list]
[*]Extraction (CX_ Prefix)
[list]
[*]In Extraction you and up to 8 total survivors spawn away from your friends and must use your smart phone's GPS to locate each other as well as once your GPS picks up the location the place where survivor AI's are holding out and require your help to barricade, and keep the horde at bay until extraction arrives where you'll need to lead them to and will be rewarded with ammo and weapons. Each holdout is randomly selected as is the number of survivors you must rescue. You lose one of two ways, all AI (even if you only have 1 to protect) die or all Player Survivors die. If you clear out all locations you win.
[/list]
[*]Hunted (CH_ Prefix)
[list]
[*]In Hunted you've been consumed by paranoia, greed, or believe survival lies in the resources you can gather off the corpses of other survivors. You can play up to 8 or 16 players in this game-mode (Depends on server) and you score points for Killing AI/Player Zombies, Survivors, and being the last man/woman standing. You can camp it out, team up, or like most of us enjoy hunt down all survivors hoping to be the last one standing. The winner is the person with the highest score which carries on to the next round.
[/list]
[*]Contagion Panic Classic (CPC_ Prefix still WIP and Inspired by our Free Mod Zombie Panic: Source which was requested by Contagion Players)
[list]
[*]In this game mode you can play up to 8-16 players (depending on server settings) with either 1-2 survivors starting out infected with only them knowing until the change hits so watch your back as your mate may very well be turning into a zombie just behind you. Your goal in Classic is to survive a specified amount of time or kill all the zombies "spotted" in your area which your smart phone will say. There are no AI Zombies, just former survivors who've been infected or have died. Each Player Zombie death drops the number while each survivor turned zombie raises it by one. If the number of zombies spots hits 0 and all zombies are dead you also win.
[/list]
[*]Contagion Panic Objective (CPO_ Prefix still WIP and Inspired by our Free Mod Zombie Panic: Source which was requested by Contagion Players)
[list]
[*]In this game mode you can play up to 8-16 players (depending on server settings) with either 1-2 survivors starting out infected with only them knowing until the change hits so watch your back as your mate may very well be turning into a zombie just behind you. Very much like Escape you must complete a series of objectives but this time without any AI Zombies in your way. Instead you're left fending off those who have turned (Player Zombies) and there is no limit to how often they can spawn, just their numbers which grow as players die. Your smart phone again describes your objectives.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Contagion :: Current Official Maps[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]RoanokePD[/b]
[list]
[*]Currently only supports the following Game-Modes "Escape" and "CPO"
[/list]
[/list]
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-08-28_FreeWeekend/RoanokePD_Preview.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Barlowe Square[/b]
[list]
[*]Currently only supports the following Game-Modes "Escape", "Extraction", "Hunted", and "CPC"
[/list]
[/list]
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-08-28_FreeWeekend/BarloweSquare_Preview.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Biotec[/b]
[list]
[*]Currently only supports the following Game-Modes "Escape" and "Hunted"
[/list]
[/list]
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec06_th.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Stone Creek[/b]
[list]
[*]Currently only supports the following Game-Mode "Escape"
[/list]
[/list]
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek01_th.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Aurora Estates[/b]
[list]
[*]Currently only supports the following Game-Modes "Extraction" and "Hunted"
[/list]
[/list]
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-08-28_FreeWeekend/AuroraEstates_Preview.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Cyprus Park[/b]
[list]
[*]Currently only supports the following Game-Modes "Hunted" and "CPC"
[/list]
[/list]
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-08-28_FreeWeekend/CyprusPark_Preview.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Pioneer Express[/b]
[list]
[*]Currently only supports the following Game-Modes "Hunted" and "CPC"
[/list]
[/list]
[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-08-28_FreeWeekend/PioneerExpress_Preview.jpg[/img]

There is quite a lot more that we do like our Weekly Official Contagion WebComic, "Friday Frenzy" and "Contagious Gaming" Stream & Giveaway, daily interaction with the community trying to show we're not here to make a quick buck but want to help where we can and appreciate constructive criticism.
[url=http://www.contagion-game.com/comicbook/][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/images/comicbook/previews/week20/cont_checking_out_wk20_steam.jpg[/img][/url]

Be sure to check out [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/558752451170175902/]Developer's "What's Next?" Discussion[/url]

Have a great Weekend!

-The Contagion Team

notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/Contagion_Store_Announcement_Preview.png[/img][/url]

We've got numerous maps in the making, our Free DLC nearly there, new weapons, a significant number of bug fixes and tweaking to the existing system, and more on the way. If all goes as planned we're to be on the Steam Front Page for a Free Weekend with Discount for those that can't afford full price or those that want to get a taste before buying/not buying.

Also, a bit delayed but I've been squashing bugs left and right thanks to our PTs and the community but here is the latest update of our Official Contagion Web Comic and it's about time things started to pick up don't you agree?

[h1]Official Contagion Comic - Chapter 3 :: Week 8[/h1]

[url=http://www.contagion-game.com/comicbook/][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/images/comicbook/chapters/contagion_breakdown_cover_620_preview.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Contagion - Biotec, Stone Creek, and more in July Update!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/Contagion_Store_Announcement_Preview.png[/img][/url]

As promised we've released our much anticipated Zombie Panic: Source Biotec Remake (Escape & Hunted Game-Modes), Stone Creek (Escape Game-Mode but in many ways Survival gameplay) the most popular Workshop map now in our Official rotation, our new Melee System that is not only much more user friendly but now with bladed weapons can more than cut off limbs but now decapitate zombies as well!

Of course we updated all existing maps with improvements, optimization, bug fixes, and exploits being removed.

Here is a look at these new maps!

[h1]Contagion - Biotec[/h1]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec01.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec01_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec02.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec02_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec03.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec03_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec04.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec04_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec05.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec05_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec06.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec06_th.jpg[/img][/url]

Once again seek out the experimental vaccine that may hold the key humanities very survival! But it would seem that Biotec security was unable to either handle the horde invading... or was it from within?

[h1]Contagion - Stone Creek[/h1]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek01.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek01_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek02.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek02_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek03.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek03_th.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek04.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek04_th.jpg[/img][/url]

With the most subscribers on Workshop and our promise to bring the communities favorites into the Official rotation (with permission of author) we're happy to include the very claustrophobic, classic survival like Escape map "Stone Creek" in our Official list of maps!

Check out what went out in our July update!

[h1]July 31st Update - Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new map Biotec (Escape & Hunted Game-Modes)
[*] Added new map by popularity from Workshop Stone Creek (Escape Game-Mode)
[*] Added gasmask objective item that prevents harmful chemicals from affecting player
[*] Added gasmask voice muffling for survivors
[*] Added Keycard objective item for unlocking security doors
[*] Added keycard entity system for mappers
[*] Added Zombie Decapitation with bladed weapons (Kabar not included)
[*] Updated Melee System (WIP for balance) with decapitation
[*] Improved navigation mesh for all existing maps
[*] Changes to networking system in an attempt to fix LAN related issues
[*] Kill Cam with the above mentioned bladed weapons also decapitate zombies when using stealth kill
[*] Fixed weapon holstering issues
[*] Fixed exploits, issues, and bugs on all maps from bug reports by the community (Thank you!)
[/list]

notes.content:

With the most subscribers on Workshop and our promise to bring the communities favorites into the Official rotation (with permission of author) we're happy to include the very claustrophobic, classic survival like Escape map "Stone Creek" in our Official list of maps!

Check out what went out in our July update!

[h1]July 31st Update - Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new map Biotec (Escape & Hunted Game-Modes)
[*] Added new map by popularity from Workshop Stone Creek (Escape Game-Mode)
[*] Added gasmask objective item that prevents harmful chemicals from affecting player
[*] Added gasmask voice muffling for survivors
[*] Added Keycard objective item for unlocking security doors
[*] Added keycard entity system for mappers
[*] Added Zombie Decapitation with bladed weapons (Kabar not included)
[*] Updated Melee System (WIP for balance) with decapitation
[*] Improved navigation mesh for all existing maps
[*] Changes to networking system in an attempt to fix LAN related issues
[*] Kill Cam with the above mentioned bladed weapons also decapitate zombies when using stealth kill
[*] Fixed weapon holstering issues
[*] Fixed exploits, issues, and bugs on all maps from bug reports by the community (Thank you!)

notes.title: Contagion - Update June 16th :: Split Screen Local Co-op, AI tweaks, Linux/Mac Update, and much more!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2013_09_13_Kickstarter/Contagion_Logo_450.png[/img][/url]

It's been a long time coming for many but we've finally added Local Co-op Split-screen without the need like other games to go through a series of steps to get it working right. 2 Game-pads, Keyboard & Mouse & Game-pad, the days of Consoles and PC games lacking this feature may be dying out but this is something we grew up with and playing with a friend or sibling without having to lan was a hot topic for gamers and owners of Contagion so we can now tick our Local Co-op in the listings. We will continue to watch over it and tweak here and there to improve the overall quality of course (no aim assist for game-pads, sorry heh).

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-06-16_Update_Splitscreen/Contagion_Local_Coop_Splitscreen.jpg[/img][/url]

Our Survivor AI accuracy is dependent on difficulty as well as commands that are allowed making Extraction while it was still difficult, more realistic and this will only improve throughout the year.

We've also enabled more server commands for Server Hosts to use to setup their servers closer to what they'd like them to be (Dec went to bed and I don't have the list heh)

Check out the changes below in this weeks update-

[h1]Contagion - Update June 16th Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added split-screen support to Contagion, also added menu in options to enable it. (WIP)
[*] Adjusted survivor AI accuracy to be less perfect on easier difficulties.
[*] Enabled additional console commands to be allowed to be changed by server hosts.
[*] Fixed the ability to drop a grenade before infection and kill ex-teammates.
[*] Fixed survivor AI being able to receive commands while inside a house or while climbing.
[*] Fixed IED and phone screen disappearing near water or mirror elements sometimes.
[*] Fixed memory leak issues with multiple flash-lights.
[*] Fixed possible server crash-loop when blending as a zombie.
[/list]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-06-16_Update_Splitscreen/linux_mac_icon.png[/img][/url] This week we have updates on both Linux and the Mac build. Valve has been quite helpful in keeping on things an we have started working not only on our Linux but also our Mac builds! Whether they are able to release simultaneously or not is yet to be seen but this is great news to those who are eager to play Contagion on their Linux machine/Steam Machine and/or Mac!

Also for those that missed our Official Contagion - Let's Play Top 10 Countdown with prizes exceeding $12,500 check it out!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DOyyfFzsE5g

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/site_images/contagion-now-on-steam.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Contagion - Update June 16th :: Split Screen Local Co-op, AI tweaks, Linux/Mac Update, and much more!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2013_09_13_Kickstarter/Contagion_Logo_450.png[/img][/url]

It's been a long time coming for many but we've finally added Local Co-op Split-screen without the need like other games to go through a series of steps to get it working right. 2 Game-pads, Keyboard & Mouse & Game-pad, the days of Consoles and PC games lacking this feature may be dying out but this is something we grew up with and playing with a friend or sibling without having to lan was a hot topic for gamers and owners of Contagion so we can now tick our Local Co-op in the listings. We will continue to watch over it and tweak here and there to improve the overall quality of course (no aim assist for game-pads, sorry heh).

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-06-16_Update_Splitscreen/Contagion_Local_Coop_Splitscreen.jpg[/img][/url]

Our Survivor AI accuracy is dependent on difficulty as well as commands that are allowed making Extraction while it was still difficult, more realistic and this will only improve throughout the year.

We've also enabled more server commands for Server Hosts to use to setup their servers closer to what they'd like them to be (Dec went to bed and I don't have the list heh)

Check out the changes below in this weeks update-

[h1]Contagion - Update June 16th Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added split-screen support to Contagion, also added menu in options to enable it. (WIP)
[*] Adjusted survivor AI accuracy to be less perfect on easier difficulties.
[*] Enabled additional console commands to be allowed to be changed by server hosts.
[*] Fixed the ability to drop a grenade before infection and kill ex-teammates.
[*] Fixed survivor AI being able to receive commands while inside a house or while climbing.
[*] Fixed IED and phone screen disappearing near water or mirror elements sometimes.
[*] Fixed memory leak issues with multiple flash-lights.
[*] Fixed possible server crash-loop when blending as a zombie.
[/list]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-06-16_Update_Splitscreen/linux_mac_icon.png[/img][/url] This week we have updates on both Linux and the Mac build. Valve has been quite helpful in keeping on things an we have started working not only on our Linux but also our Mac builds! notes.title: Contagion - Update June 4th :: Crossbow deadlier than ever, Linux Update, and 9 Ways Contagion Brings the Zombie Genre Back From the Dead!
notes.content:
I apologize for the delay in announcing a release that went out nearly 12 hours ago but sometimes this is a good sign and in our case and for the future of Contagion it is! We hope you approve of the weekly updates and will be releasing more content shortly and more often very soon!
[h1]9 Ways Contagion Brings the Zombie Genre Back From the Dead :: Game Cupid[/h1] [quote]“Oh great! Another generic zombie game!” I hear you say. Stop rolling your eyes a second and hear me out.[/quote] We can't help but get a jump start when Contagion goes from a generic Zombie game to a "Oh" moment and the hard work, design, and depth of the game just clicks for users. No hand holding, but a well thought out and challenging game that attempts to hit the mark but only time will tell. Check out the full review at [url=http://www.gamecupid.com/content/feature-game-contagion]GameCupid.com[/url] [h1]Where we are at with Linux (Linux Update as promised)[/h1] Linux progresses and we're quite confident that we'll soon be able to release our Linux and Mac platforms soon but as we said last week there are walls and the latest one is an issue with networking on Valve's end. Will keep you up to date but have made vast steps forward since the last update. Here is what we put out in today's patch [h1]June 4th Update - Changelog:[/h1] [list] [*] Added 'you are here' maps around Barlowe to help navigation. [*] Added glow symbol underneath infected survivors when seen through zombie vision. [*] Added additional checks to try solve invisible survivor glitch. [*] Improved many areas on Barlowe square and fixed lots of exploited areas. [*] Riot zombies in Panic gamemodes can now cause infection with claws but not with grapple bite. [*] Bigger penalty in Hunted for suicide and new penalty for drawing a round. [*] Many navmesh fixes to Barlowe Square to help with Extraction. [*] Fixed zombies disappearing when killed instead of seeing a corpse. [*] Adjustments to crossbow accuracy and power. [*] Adjusted GPS in Barlowe Extraction to not be so bright. [*] Adjusted delay after grapple that zombies can hit survivors. [*] Adjusted microphone drawing in Panic gamemodes scoreboard. [*] Adjusted 16 player scoreboard to change to 16 slot layout when number of players goes above 8. [*] Adjusted character breathing sounds when running out of stamina. [*] Fixed ability for some weapons to do large friendly fire on Normal difficulty. [*] Fixed ability to join a Hunted game as a survivor in the last remaining minutes. [*] Fixed pathing entities causing navigation issues on Barlowe. [*] Removed per-difficulty damage adjustment for Grenades. [/list] Due to the hours and sleep deprivation and so I can focus on getting new content out like CE_Biotec ASAP, Joe is stepping in handle our General Discussion. Please be gentle! We will still be watching over and helping those in need however!
He're a look at what we're working on atm - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/558752451170175902/]-Here-[/url] -The Contagion Team

<center>[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2013_09_13_Kickstarter/Contagion_Logo_450.png[/img][/url]</center>

I apologize for the delay in announcing a release that went out nearly 12 hours ago but sometimes this is a good sign and in our case and for the future of Contagion it is! We hope you approve of the weekly updates and will be releasing more content shortly and more often very soon!

<center>[url=http://www.gamecupid.com/content/feature-game-contagion][img]http://www.gamecupid.com/sites/default/files/logo-v4_1.png[/img][/url]</center>
[h1]9 Ways Contagion Brings the Zombie Genre Back From the Dead :: Game Cupid[/h1]
[quote]“Oh great! Another generic zombie game!” I hear you say. 
Stop rolling your eyes a second and hear me out.[/quote]
We can't help but get a jump start when Contagion goes from a generic Zombie game to a "Oh" moment and the hard work, design, and depth of the game just clicks for users. No hand holding, but a well thought out and challenging game that attempts to hit the mark but only time will tell.

Check out the full review at [url=http://www.gamecupid.com/content/feature-game-contagion]GameCupid.com[/url]

[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-05-18_16players/linux_icon.png[/img][h1]Where we are at with Linux (Linux Update as promised)[/h1]
Linux progresses and we're quite confident that we'll soon be able to release our Linux and Mac platforms soon but as we said last week there are walls and the latest one is an issue with networking on Valve's end. Will keep you up to date but have made vast steps forward since the last update.

Here is what we put out in today's patch

[h1]June 4th Update - Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 'you are here' maps around Barlowe to help navigation.
[*] Added glow symbol underneath infected survivors when seen through zombie vision.
[*] Added additional checks to try solve invisible survivor glitch.
[*] Improved many areas on Barlowe square and fixed lots of exploited areas.
[*] Riot zombies in Panic gamemodes can now cause infection with claws but not with grapple bite.
[*] Bigger penalty in Hunted for suicide and new penalty for drawing a round.
[*] Many navmesh fixes to Barlowe Square to help with Extraction.
[*] Fixed zombies disappearing when killed instead of seeing a corpse.
[*] Adjustments to crossbow accuracy and power.
[*] Adjusted GPS in Barlowe Extraction to not be so bright.
[*] Adjusted delay after grapple that zombies can hit survivors.
[*] Adjusted microphone drawing in Panic gamemodes scoreboard.
[*] Adjusted 16 player scoreboard to change to 16 slot layout when number of players goes above 8.
[*] Adjusted character breathing sounds when running out of stamina.
[*] Fixed ability for some weapons to do large friendly fire on Normal difficulty.
[*] Fixed ability to join a Hunted game as a survivor in the last remaining minutes.
[*] Fixed pathing entities causing navigation issues on Barlowe.
[*] Removed per-difficulty damage adjustment for Grenades.
[/list]

Due to the hours and sleep deprivation and so I can focus on getting new content out like CE_Biotec ASAP, Joe is stepping in handle our General Discussion. Please be gentle! We will still be watching over and helping those in need however!

notes.title: Contagion - Friday Frenzy Stream & Unique Giveaway, FF Ep 25 (Epic), and more!
notes.content:
We've had quite a busy week finalizing company work, leaps and bounds on CE_Biotec and new features, Linux & Mac progress which we'll talk about next week when we release the next patch (Not with Linux or Mac for those that might confuse this sentence), Layered Animation system, Implementing our new Motion Capture Animations, CE_Harvest and CF_UnionStation (Flatline) looking good for our first free DLC bundle, and so much more. Obviously we've got a lot going on but today is about FRIDAY FRENZY and today we will be doing something a bit more interesting regarding who wins a free copy of Contagion. Instead of posting a keyword then using a random generator to select we're going to ask you to predict certain stats and the person closest to the stats at the end of round will receive a copy of Contagion. This will be done 3x as we will be handing out 3 keys. We will give you a heads up when to toss your prediction as well as an example so you know how to post your prediction. To be eligible to win a copy of Contagion you must be a follower of the channel. When we announce it's time to post your predictions remember you can only post 1 prediction. If you post more than one, your first prediction is the only one we will consider so think carefully. If someone else has posted a prediction you planned on before you, yours will be ignored so be sure yours is unique. Do not worry, we will give a full description of what to predict and how it works for each game-mode we play today. Stream goes live in [b]30mins[/b] from the posting of this Announcement! So in the meantime check out Episode 25 (our best yet imho) which shows off Steamworks mods, Panic (before it got updated this week), and some epic kills. http://youtu.be/QRhTeemSX_A

We hope you enjoy today's stream and giveaway and remember more news coming early next week with our next patch!
As always we will be having a Q&A at the end of our Stream answering all sorts of questions and hinting at what's to come! He're a look at what we're working on atm - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/558752451170175902/]-Here-[/url] -The Contagion Team

notes.title: CvG, The Developers, and Community take a moment to mourn the loss of Kakashi
notes.content:
Sorry for the delay. The loss of Kakashi at the age of only 21 came as a shock to all of us and we hope his Family, Friends, and loved ones including the community know how much he was loved back. Some people shine too bright for too short a time. [quote]Yesterday 5-24-2014 morning at 3am, Gianni Duprez, also known as Kakashi, died of heart failure. He was 21 years old. He joined Convict Gaming's ZPS community 3 years ago as a regular player on the server. At the beginning he didn't use his mic and would only type. His cheery personality entertained the whole server. Then came a time where he started to use voice chat - everyone loved listening to him, his way of describing things and explaining them made everyone smile. His laughter was infectious. He became an admin for CvG soon after and all of us can agree he has been one of the best admins we have ever had. He was loyal to the community and to his friends, always proving he had an open ear for every problem. The next step for him was to become a ZPS Community Leader back in 2013. He always kept his cool, tried to keep his hours up and manage being there for the admins and his wonderful girlfriend that he met in 2012. Everyone knew how much he loved her - he would mention her whenever he could, all of us thought it was endearing. Kakashi tried to be the best friend he could be, to every single person. He would let you listen to a new song he had found and through his enthusiasm you would start loving the song as well. Whenever you played a game, he would try to join you to share the fun and laughter and if he couldn't, he would always let you know why. Kakashi made sure you knew you were his friend, often letting you know how much you meant to him. He took care of every friendship and so it is this that is going to be missed the most. He was a happy, hard working, always cheery type of guy and was taken from this world too early.[/quote]
Sometimes our passion takes hold but our body is not up for the challenge. You have the love and respect of CvG, Zombie Panic: Source, Contagion, and I'm sure many other communities! You will be missed. -All of us

notes.title: Contagion - Update May 18th :: Increased Player Slots, New SDK/Workshop, and Linux?
notes.content:
Today's update was a blast but means a bit more work for us as we've been keeping busy (wait for the gasmask). We no longer have an in-game workshop publishing tool due to the limitations it set. We've updated our ContagionSDK to include our Workshop Publishing Tool which now allows what it couldn't before the option to review your screenshot, update existing addons, update details of addons, and all a modders could hope for. We can add to this later thanks to the setup as well.
With the new PANIC modes we had been testing 16 players using bots. But because we could never get enough ppl together in team due to our small numbers we put it out there and testing was a huge success! Both Hunted and our Panic Game-Modes support 16 players (our Escape and Extraction game modes do not at this time) and we've got our Official Contagion Gameservers Servers running 16 slots right now (Their is maintenance being done over at GS so there may be stragglers which we'll go over)! Gameservers has updated their options from 8 slots to now being able to rent between 8 and 16 slots.
This is going to require balancing and don't worry the HUD is temporary! Replacements coming soon.
Also for those who've been patiently been sitting around we want you to know that we will have an update regarding Linux at the end of the month. Michael Brune is working hard solely on the release of both the Server Binaries and Platform! (More on Mac asap!) [h1]May 18th Update - Changelog:[/h1] [list] [*] Added Hunted and both Panic game-modes the ability to play up to 16 players now [*] Added Contagion Workshop Manager to the ContagionSDK. Removed in-game add-on publisher for favour of better software [*] Added ability for mappers to set different spawn weapons for survivors [*] Tweaked HUD elements to support 16 players on those servers [*] Fixed riot-zombie having female legs for those who picked a female character [*] Fixed issue with first-person hands movement 'lagging' when in dedicated servers [*] Fixes to Barlowe Square nav-mesh, fenced areas and fixed some camping spots [/list] Remember more updates this month and major updates every month of 2014 so keep checking in for more info!
He're a look at what we're working on atm - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/558752451170175902/]-Here-[/url] -The Contagion Team

Today's update was a blast but means a bit more work for us as we've been keeping busy (wait for the gasmask). We no longer have an in-game workshop publishing tool due to the limitations it set. We've updated our ContagionSDK to include our Workshop Publishing Tool which now allows what it couldn't before the option to review your screenshot, update existing addons, update details of addons, and all a modders could hope for. We can add to this later thanks to the setup as well.

<center>[url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-05-18_16players/Contagion_SDK_Authoring_Tools.png[/img][/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-05-18_16players/Contagion_Steam_Workshop_Publishing_Tools.png[/img][/url]</center>

With the new PANIC modes we had been testing 16 players using bots. But because we could never get enough ppl together in team due to our small numbers we put it out there and testing was a huge success!

Both Hunted and our Panic Game-Modes support 16 players (our Escape and Extraction game modes do not at this time) and we've got our Official Contagion Gameservers Servers running 16 slots right now (Their is maintenance being done over at GS so there may be stragglers which we'll go over)! Gameservers has updated their options from 8 slots to now being able to rent between 8 and 16 slots.

<center>[url=http://www.gameservers.com/game_servers/contagion.php][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-05-18_16players/Contagion_16player_Gameservers.png[/img][/url]</center>

This is going to require balancing and don't worry the HUD is temporary! Replacements coming soon.

<center>[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-05-18_16players/Contagion_16players_Screen01.jpg][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-05-18_16players/Contagion_16players_Screen01_th.jpg[/img][/url]</center>

[img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-05-18_16players/linux_icon.png[/img]Also for those who've been patiently been sitting around we want you to know that we will have an update regarding Linux at the end of the month. Michael Brune is working hard solely on the release of both the Server Binaries and Platform! (More on Mac asap!)

[h1]May 18th Update - Changelog:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added Hunted and both Panic game-modes the ability to play up to 16 players now
[*] Added Contagion Workshop Manager to the ContagionSDK. Removed in-game add-on publisher for favour of better software
[*] Added ability for mappers to set different spawn weapons for survivors
[*] Tweaked HUD elements to support 16 players on those servers
[*] Fixed riot-zombie having female legs for those who picked a female character
[*] Fixed issue with first-person hands movement 'lagging' when in dedicated servers
[*] Fixes to Barlowe Square nav-mesh, fenced areas and fixed some camping spots
[/list]

Remember more updates this month and major updates every month of 2014 so keep checking in for more info!

<center>[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/site_images/contagion-now-on-steam.png[/img][/url]</center>

notes.title: Contagion - Early May Updates! Check out the new video!
notes.content:
As you know now we've released our Official Contagion SDK Authoring Tools, Steam Workshop (Update on that soon!), [url=http://www.contagion-game.com/wiki/]Contagion WIKI[/url], and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/11/]Modding Discussions[/url] as many of us started out as modders and still strongly believe in the modding community even as we release unofficial mods ourselves and continue to improve on the tools and tutorials!
Speaking of improvements! Our guys and FXBooth have been working hard improving animations, effects, facial expressions, visuals, audio, and more for our [b]Enhanced Contagion - Source Filmmaker Cinematic Trailer[/b] which is different enough you've got to check it out now in full 1080p! For those that are curious the songs name is "Sleep" by Forbnl (Ed Harrison & John Dekker)
We also released the much anticipated and requested Contagion Panic Game-Modes Inspired by my very own award winning Zombie Panic: Source HL2 Modification! (We still plan to find the time to undo the damage done with the last couple leads and get it up and rolling again bigger and better as soon as that is possible)
We know many are already using the modding tools to port some of our favorite maps over and others have shown a strong interest in modding for it. As we've made clear, this does not replace ZPS but we're hoping our veterans will step in and help us in quickly balancing it out. We're looking for enthusiasts in this regard to post in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/558755530231266756/]Contagion Panic Specific Discussion[/url]
We've mentioned CE_Biotec is nearly complete and hinted at CE_Harvest as well as our upcoming DLC Bundle, Flatline Game-Mode, New Characters, Weapons, and much more.
Have a look at our current updates in more detail below! [h1]May 11th Update - Changelog[/h1] [list] [*] Added Contagion Steam Workshop and full in-game addon publishing support [*] Added Panic Classic and Objective game-modes [*] Added Panic game-mode to pre-existing maps (look forward to seeing your published maps) [*] Added Riot Zombie as Player Controlled main zombie for Panic game-modes [*] Added Riot Zombie first-person hand textures [*] Added New Zombie Player HUD [*] Added Golf-Club Kick-starter weapon [*] Added Player Zombie 'Command' ability to control a horde that is following you [*] Added Survivor breathing sounds when sprinting [*] Further optimisation to hit-box code to try improve on current system [*] Fixed random survivor changing per round [/list] [h1]May 12th Update - Changelog[/h1] [list] [*] Improved zombie pathing on Barlowe Square [*] Fixed Achievements and Key Binds menu elements not being visible [*] Improved code that gets rid of used weapons when their action is complete (e.g. FirstAid Kit) [*] Fixed non-chosen player always being the Riot Zombie in Panic game-modes [*] Fixed flashlight sound repeating, when on dedicated servers [*] Fixed AI zombies not spawning when changing from a Panic server [*] Fixed broken survivors spawn system on Escape maps [*] Improved zombie pathing on Barlowe Square [*] Fixed Eugene's materials to glow when he is seen through Zombie Vision [*] Fixed IED quick-dropping glitch that caused weapon HUD to order incorrectly [/list] [h1]May ??? Update - Changelog[/h1] [list] [*] More! Remember, we're listening to you guys so don't be afraid to share constructive criticism with us! [/list] Something worth mentioning is our attendance this year at Downtown Lakeland, Florida's ZombieFest this October 11th as they reach for this years Guinness World Record for most Zombies in one location and Contagion will be the one and only game setup at the local Club right in the middle of it all! We plan to go big and many of the team will be there including myself for a change!
More updates throughout the month and every month of 2014! He're a look at what we're working on atm - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/558752451170175902/]-Here-[/url] -The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Update May 11th :: Steam Workshop & Contagion Panic Game-Modes
notes.content:
Our Contagion Steam Workshop is finally out allowing users to publish their maps and other mods! Be sure to check our [url=http://www.contagion-game.com/wiki/]Contagion WIKI[/url] and visit our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/11/]Mapping & Modding[/url] discussions to share your work before publishing! Worth mentioning we will be adding in an in-game store later for the freelancers, those looking to step into that world, or those who've honed their skills allowing for Unofficial content to be sold (so long as no one is infringing on anyone's work) and possibly including work for Official content (no eta on this just yet).
Which is a perfect combination with our newly released (WIP) much demanded and recently added ZPS inspired "Panic" Game-Modes which right now are working on edited versions of existing maps especially with all the talk of porting maps over via workshop. This does not replace ZPS but we're hoping our veterans will step in and help us in quickly balancing it out. We're looking for enthusiasts in this regard to post in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/558755530231266756/]Panic Specific Discussion[/url]
More has been added and more is being added with CE_Biotec nearly done and looking at an early release next month as well as much more every month. There will be balancing and fixes on anything we catch but as you can see we've even improved hit-box code! We are always listening both good & bad and even when we can't see it ourselves we rely on your eyes and comments. [h1]Preview Biotec[/h1]
Also keeping up with our Kickstarter backers another has contacted us and requested this golf club!
[h1]May 11th Update - Changelog[/h1] [list] [*] Added Contagion Steam Workshop and full in-game addon publishing support [*] Added Panic Classic and Objective game-modes [*] Added Panic game-mode to pre-existing maps (look forward to seeing your published maps) [*] Added Riot Zombie as Player Controlled main zombie for Panic game-modes [*] Added Riot Zombie first-person hand textures [*] Added New Zombie Player HUD [*] Added Golf-Club Kick-starter weapon [*] Added Player Zombie 'Command' ability to control a horde that is following you [*] Added Survivor breathing sounds when sprinting [*] Further optimisation to hit-box code to try improve on current system [*] Fixed random survivor changing per round [/list] (UPDATE JUST WENT OUT. Edited announcement to include) [h1]May 12th Update - Changelog[/h1] [list] [*] Improved zombie pathing on Barlowe Square [*] Fixed Achievements and Key Binds menu elements not being visible [*] Improved code that gets rid of used weapons when their action is complete (e.g. FirstAid Kit) [*] Fixed non-chosen player always being the Riot Zombie in Panic game-modes [*] Fixed flashlight sound repeating, when on dedicated servers [*] Fixed AI zombies not spawning when changing from a Panic server [*] Fixed broken survivors spawn system on Escape maps [*] Improved zombie pathing on Barlowe Square [*] Fixed Eugene's materials to glow when he is seen through Zombie Vision [*] Fixed IED quick-dropping glitch that caused weapon HUD to order incorrectly [/list] As we've said we've put together a budget that allows us to release major updates including free content, free DLC Bundles, updated content, new features, improved performance, multiple platforms, multiple peripheral support like Oculus, and much more every month this year and into 2015! notes.title: Contagion - Update April 27th
notes.content:
This weeks update features Survivor AI that can hold their own while on their own or as they follow you to the extraction point as well as a number of improvements and major fixes! Here's a look at the changelog for today's update- [h1]Contagion - Update April 27th[/h1] [list] [*] Survivor AI now have weapons, better AI, better navigation and voices. [*] Adjustments to zombie sounds attenuation and variety. [*] Added ability to load multiple .bnk files for custom add-on maps. [*] Added new clipping types for mappers to block areas for specifically zombies or survivors. [*] Added better communication system with AI survivors and the ability to command them with voice-commands. [*] Improved AI for Survivors when they're being extracted. [*] Optimisations to zombie AI to speed up net-load. [*] Fixed VOIP issues and icon above survivors heads at all times. [*] Fixed cheat-detection code being activated by servers with non-default tick-rates. [*] Fixed survivors not actually escaping at the end of escape and still existing in the world. [*] Fixed grenade damage not killing players on all difficulties. [*] Fixed Draw and Holster sounds being audible to everyone when a survivor spawns. [*] Fixed zombies spawning in extraction areas on Barlowe. [*] Fixed broken pathing near gunstore on Barlowe. [*] Fixed issues with ForcedIP being enabled for people who don't need it. [*] Fixed spawning in the bank at random times on Barlowe Escape. [*] Fixed fences in Barlowe not being able to be climbed by Zombie players or AI. [*] Fixed Survivor voices. [*] Fixed glass being able to be broken on non-active houses by throwing weapons at the glass. [*] Fixed net_graph showing for users who didn't enable it. [/list] [b]Remember these fixes may still be updating on our servers so if you receive a **** differs error it just means the server is not yet updated. The update is still going out to servers.[/b] There are less than 2 weeks left before we lock down our "Contagon - Let's Play" competition. May 9th we stop accepting new videos and start judging them! [h1]Contagion - Let's Play Competition with prizes exceeding $12,500 USD[/h1] For information visit- http://www.contagion-game.com/lets-play/ and/or watch our instructional video
