notes.title: Official Contagion SDK is out now!
notes.content:
Actually it was released on Sunday as planned but one of our marketing campaign affiliates used us to host the image on their site for a site takeover and we nearly lost hosting. Upgraded and sorted now!
We've updated your Contagion with our Official Contagion SDK which can be found in your Steam\Common\Contagion\bin\ (or ContagionBeta if you bought before Full Release) folder as it's directly linked to our Engine. For those familiar with modding will find it rather intuitive but there is more to learn even for veterans if you're looking to create a proper Contagion Map but that will either come with time or strong will and dedication. We are excited to see what you guys roll out and what becomes popular. We can only hope that some of you try to achieve more than a simple port or something rushed but it available to do just that if you wish. We hope to provide detail guides both in written and video format but for now there are some great mapping tutorials on [url=http://www.interlopers.net/]Interlopers[/url] and/or [url=http://twhl.info/index.php]TWHL[/url] to get you started. [h1]Here's your chance![/h1] [list] [*] We'll be keeping an eye out and if a map catches our eyes there may be something in it for you! [*] Have fun but try to be tasteful? [*] So many users are salivating over new content. Will you put actual time and effort in or just attempt to make another [*] Ports are to be expected but do the original creators a favor since it was their hardwork and request permission as well as providing credit where it's due. The same goes for borrowed assets. [*] Make us look bad if you can! We love great minds. [/list] [h1]What should you be catching up on?[/h1] [list] [*] [url=http://www.squirrel-lang.org/]Squirrel Scripting[/url] [*] [url=https://www.audiokinetic.com/products/wwise/]Audiokinetic's Wwise[/url] [*] [url=https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Category:Level_Design]The Basics - HL2 Modding[/url] [/list] [h1]These Forum Rules![/h1] Obviously no trolling, insulting, racial slurs, and the usual. Read our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/864969482162413738/]General Forum Rules & Guidelines[/url] to catch up before posting. [h1]What can I post?[/h1] [list] [*] Start a discussion if you have something to show and feel free to link images/videos as you progress for constructive criticism (expect people to be blunt) [*] Questions are welcome but answers may be slow to come where this hasn't been the case in other discussions so you'll need to be patient. [*] You can praise or critique but we expect you to do more than that. Be constructive or don't be surprised if your "Awesome" one word post or "Is lame" one liner is deleted. [*] Your own guides and knowledge to help others. We're a community :) [/list] This should be interesting! We still have 2 1/2 weeks left in our "Contagion - Let's Play" competition with prizes exceeding $12,500 USD so don't miss out as anyone can participate!
Above is the instructional video but you can find more information at http://www.contagion-game.com/lets-play/ To Enter you only need a copy of Contagion and a Youtube account!
We have a patch coming out soon that should improve AI and then another hopefully this coming Sunday that should be quite pleasant so don't forget to check back often! -The Contagion Team

Contagion is Now Available on Steam!

notes.title: Contagion - Major optimization and more with today's hotfix!
notes.content:
We had our Full Release on Friday and are still waiting for Valve to fix the listing issue. But with full release we ran into issues that weren't present through testing and many users with low end rigs and those who use to play even below supported min system requirements were dealing with crashes. We released a hotfix with major optimization tweaks that should have resolved all/most of those issues. We will continue to optimize and improve the quality of the latest content (yes including characters which is already being worked on) and some features that are acting up (voice volume). We did more than that with todays update so below is the changelog- [h1]Contagion :: 2014-04-13 Update/Hotfix[/h1] [list] [*] Heavily optimised game resources by almost half when settings are lowered [*] Fixed players standing on ladders stopping zombies from climbing up [*] Fixed and added back IED weapon [*] Fixed zombie spawns on Barlowe servers causing MAX EDICTS crash [*] Removed lots of unnecessary resources from the game [*] Disabled tossing objective items out of the loading bay [*] Fixed getting stuck in the overturned train in Pioneer [*] Added security cameras to Barlowe escape [*] Fixed cameras in RPD to show correctly for all players [*] Fixed lighting in Subway on Barlowe Escape [*] Fixed Singleplayer/LAN servers having default passwords [*] Fixed AI zombies getting stuck in RPD vent [*] Fixed AI zombies standing up and getting stuck when in areas that require crouching [*] Game now reads the update text on a second thread to remove the delay that sometimes occurs. [*] Fixed dropped weapons colliding with invisible barricade positions [*] Adjusted loading-screen to recieve additional messages to help keep up with changing levels [*] AI survivors now have the ability to climb ladders, small props and fences instead of getting stuck [*] AI survivors also now have the ability to get un-stuck much easier and build better paths to follow survivors [*] Fixed being able to spawn outside the map on Barlowe [*] Many navmesh fixes for various maps [*] Fixed indoor rain FX on Barlowe [/list]
We are listening and will continue to improve, add, and optimize. Yes we're also working on the SDK for a release here very soon, also working on Linux and Mac and hope to announce their release dates shortly. -The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Full Release is out! But still running on 25% discount?
notes.content:
After 5 hours of waiting on Valve to flip the switch and release our game at full price ($19.99) as Full Release on the Store's front page we felt we could wait no longer and decided to release on the date we announced repeatedly! TODAY (Yesterday for some as it's now 10am and I look forward to bed as does the rest of the team)! While it states we're currently early access we are no longer that. Yes there are bugs and hotfixes we're already planning to release immediately (after sleep... still human) like the IED which somehow got bugged but is too awesome to leave out, the design and so very much of our work is out there now! We don't mind the pricing, we just want you guys to have what was promised and we will be at it every day till you have it. We will be releasing the Contagion SDK if all goes this Sunday (again, so long as nothing goes wrong) as well as other updates. This does not mean we won't be hotfixing any issues you guys come across so post bugs in our Bug Reports discussions so we can do just that! We really hope you like the changes, and are excited for the future updates like the 1000+ Mocap animations we've been preparing since we recorded them, Linux & Mac platforms (binaries for servers to come when that comes out. No date yet but we're nearing a point where we can announce that) some other big surprises as well. I apologize for the rambling but we've been up days and so very tired. Know that we won't let you down and will enjoy the hard work everyone put into this major release. [h1]Full Release - Update Log[/h1] [list] [*] New Character Designs. [*] Barlowe Square Escape Map. [*] Added Difficulty options to Contagion. [*] New menu background videos. [*] New menu background video play-list and loading code. [*] New entire UI redesign. [*] New loading icon and loading screen. [*] New splash screen. [*] Added achievements. [*] Added achievements viewer page under Extras. [*] Created new map and gamemode selecting element. [*] New start game menu. [*] New find-game menu with matchmaking styled background server finding. [*] Completed 100% controller support for all menu's. [*] Controller settings options menu. [*] New keyboard bind menu. [*] Added new main-menu track and optional menu track to play on load. [*] New loading and credits music tracks. [*] Fixed ironsight toggle bugs and new system allows ironsight and duck toggle options instead of seporate key binds. [*] Added SteamCloud support game configuration file. [*] New map pictures for start and find game. [*] Added difficulty option elements to find and start game. [*] Fixed character selection being dark or completely black. [*] Fixed zombies standing up in vents to attack. [*] Fixed zombie AI issues when tracking sounds causing expensive AI calculations. [*] Added Extreme difficulty and difficulty based console commands for each difficulty. [*] Fixed doors opening then instantly closing on high-ping servers. [*] Added difficulty tag to servers. [*] Added voice commands and character voices. [*] Added auto voice commands. [*] Fixed sounds not starting properly on RPD. [*] Fixed infection effects appearing on new round. [*] Fixed muffled sounds caused by ingame pause menu. [*] Fixed muffled sounds when in low health. [*] Fixed old GPS position being shown to survivors on a new round in Extraction. [*] Fixed fires setting AI survivors on fire. [*] Fixed zombie players from dying instantly when on fire. [*] Fixed breakable glass sounds and amount of damage glass does to players. [*] Optimised flashlight code for far away players. [*] Fixed drop weapon and drop ammo to not 'poop' the ammo out. [*] Also fixed ammo bunching up and floating when dropped in large amounts. [*] Fixed commenting on finding a weapon or ammo straight after or before picking up an item. [*] Added survivor voice commands and sounds. E.g. jump, pain, die or melee attack. [*] Added infection on zombie damage chance for specific difficulties. [*] Added proper gamemode logic and settings for different difficulties. [*] New weapon 'BLR' added to game along with new sniper and BLR ammo. [*] Added holstering weapons when climbing a ladder. [*] Fixed zombies climbing as often when not needed. [*] Made zombie, item, weapon and ammo spawns in maps adjusted by difficulty. [*] New weapon 'IED'. [*] IED icon changing added. [*] New zombie type 'Riot Police'. Super tough zombies that can't be headshotted. [*] Added arrow ammo pack that contains 6 arrows instead of individual arrows. [*] Added ability to enable/disable infection and/or zombie players in your own servers. [*] New zombie type 'Inmates'. More common in RPD, less common in Aurora. [*] Implemented and finalized all achievements. [/list] [h1]DO NOT FORGET OUR $12,500+ "Contagion - Let's Play" Competition[/h1]
Today we also start our "Contagion - Let's Play" Competition. Visit http://www.contagion-game.com for more details and to get started as well as rules. We can't wait to see what you have in store for us!
Once again thank you for your patience and incredible support! -The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Let's Play Competition ($12,500+ USD in Prizes)
notes.content:
With our springboard Indie Game "Contagion" a Co-op/Multiplayer Zombie Survival Horror FPS/First Person Shooter releasing shortly, we're excited to announce our largest Official Contagion related Competition to date. The Official Contagion - Let's Play Competition! The competition will coincide with the Full Release of Contagion this Friday, April 11th at 12PM Noon PST (GMT - 7:00) and end at the same time a month later on Friday, May 9th!
This is a unique competition where almost anyone can participate for major prizes exceeding $12,500 USD by just playing Contagion and sharing it with the rest of the world. For an Instructional Video & Direct Links to everything you need to enter including our rules and prizes please visit - http://www.contagion-game.com/lets-play/ We claim this to be a unique competition because unlike the usual game competitions you do not need to be an artist, developer, level designer, musician, programmer, or an expert in any specific field. You just need to have access to the Game, something to record with (Fraps for example), in some cases a video editor (Windows Movie Maker for example), a pre-existing or newly created YouTube account, must be a member of our Official Steam Group to post your entries (no more than 3 per user), and your imagination. The example applications are free and there are many others available that you may prefer. In the end what matters is that we will be judging each video whether it be friends just playing through the game, goofing about, immersing themselves and playing tactically, a players guide to a specific map or the game as a whole, a well-executed review of the game, or let your imagination run loose. We will disregard trolling, racism, and other obvious rule breaking videos. We won't be judging a video on is how much was spent on software, number of subscribers, views, or the user's general popularity. This gives everyone a chance at making it into the Top 10! With less than a week left till the 11th take a look at the videos and reviews and see if Contagion is right for you as the 25% discount will no longer apply on Full release so now is the best time to buy especially for the competition since it'll be over by Summer!

notes.title: Contagion - Update 4872 includes Barlowe Square "Extraction", Optimization, Hud updates, and much more
notes.content:
We recently revealed Barlowe Square with the "Hunted" game-mode and today we released "Extraction" as promised. We're currently working on further optimizing and polishing Barlowe Square as well as "Escape" but we haven't stopped there as work on a new firearm. April 11th we will release a more optimized version of Contagion with improved AI, Full Release final features (more to come later), fully polished, and following the release we will continue with our Contagion SDK release, Achievements, Steamworks, Gametracker, Sourcemod, new content, even more free content in the form of Free DLC bundles. While we're excited we also quite nervous even with all the praise and support of our community which we're incredibly grateful for. We have some exciting stuff coming up we've kept to our selves as a surprise to our community and we hope you'll be just as stoked as we are when we reveal it. That said we just finished our Recent Facebook competition with numerous entries and will be announcing the winners on the 20th!
We look forward to announcing the winners and future winners! [h1]"Early Access" BUILD 4872[/h1] [list] [*] Added new version of Barlowe Square "Extraction" which is very much a WIP [*] Improved and fixed navmesh and spawn issues on Barlowe Square "Hunted" [*] Optimised weapon HUD code, added new commands and system for HUD and switching weapons (Required to update weapon select binds both mouse wheel and keys) [*] Fixed bug that caused weapon commands not to work properly [*] Melee weapons are now able to smash out our new glass saving on ammo [*] Added End Of Round UI for each gamemode with new awards and stats for specific modes coming soon [*] Flashlights for other players now have LOD's which causes players further away from rendering full expensive lights [*] New ambient sounds for Barlowe Square to fix missing rain sounds when outside [*] Adjusted lighting and weapons on Pioneer Express [*] Optimised flashlight code when turning flashlights on for the first time [*] New props and detailing on Barlowe Square and Pioneer Express [*] Fixed navmesh issues on Barlowe Square and Pioneer Express [/list]
[h1]Friday Frenzy Returns![/h1] I chose to cancel last weeks Friday Frenzy to watch my daughter graduate and share what she learned over the year. I am a proud daddy but I'm looking forward to returning to our weekly schedule! Here is Episode 19 (sorry for my cold) and Episode 20 is this Friday! http://youtu.be/y1JgMwQJDiI
We stream our Official Contagion "Friday Frenzy" and/or "Contagious Gaming" via our Twitch.Tv Account at- http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0 every Friday @ 7:00PM PST/PDT (GMT- 8:00) -Click here for current time- and will pass out one or more free copies of Contagion during the Stream! We're very close to Release so for those who've shown their support be vigilant and be sure to report any bugs you run into whether or not we may know of them. We want to release a solid title you all can be proud of! We want to thank all of you again for everything!
-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Release Date :: Events :: Media Blitz :: More!
notes.content:
In just over a month we will no longer be labeled "Early Access" or Beta (worth pointing out the 25% discount will be gone at this point as well). We look forward to the release of our final maps for release including their game-modes and some other surprises but what we're hoping to prove to many (can't win them all) is that both Kickstarter and Early Access are not just options to be abused but vital resources to both big and small Companies. A success story in our case! Full Release does not mean the development of Contagion ends there... We will be adding new content, features, further optimization, server support, and adjusting balance (with the option for Server Hosts to adjust theirs as well or pick from pre-defined options). We are still working on our Linux and Mac platform releases and our Free DLC (Something like what's described above but more of a pack including new characters, maps, game-mode, and weapons). It's because of this we plan to travel the globe whether to mingle with Industry contacts/friends and/or run a booth to further promote Contagion, our Free DLC, make new friends and meet some of the Community! Click the image below for our Events list with Events, Dates, and Times-
We hope to see as many of you as we can! Also very important to note is our new Official Contagion Facebook page now that we will be sharing media, news, Before and After Full Release! If you want to know what new weapon we're working on, check out the latest map, render, character, prop, etc. Our new Facebook will be where the information is first provided. Our contests (I believe Joe and Tom have something in the works) will also be posted here. Joe who will be handling PR will be doing his best to get as much information and the stuff you love as often as possible and will be using this as a portal to do so. Time to dust off your facebook account or sign up, visit the page, and like so you don't miss any of the good stuff now that we have someone dedicated to the task with no more excuses about it getting in the way of development! [b]New Official Contagion Facebook Page-[/b] https://www.facebook.com/contagion.game
We told you 2014 would be a very exciting time for all of us and now is the time to learn about Contagion, follow our updates, and share with friends as we reach Full Release and more! You guy's got us this far and we have no immediate plans on taking any breaks. -The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Update 4366 Release Date Announced! New Weapon, Bug Fixes, and more!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][/url]
We would like to start this announcement off by announcing our intended Full Release date: [b]April 11th, 2014[/b] Yes this means we plan to have Barlowe Square, Pioneer Express, All new mocap animations, all new sounds, new features, and a proper balancing and polish phase all done in roughly 1 1/2 months. This also includes an all new Main Menu/UI/Hud and sometime between now and then updated characters, each character with a complete voice set, localization for numerous Countries across the globe, and our Release Trailer plus quite a bit more. All our hard work will start pouring out to those who already own a copy of the game and we will continue to release builds after Full Release which are not just the Free DLC we promised time and time again. The SDK will be released soon after Full Release and prior to release Server Hosts will have the options they require to host their servers as they wish (no ETA on Sourcemod/Metamod just yet but it is being worked on). Today we released some significant changes and fixes as well as a new weapon and will continue to release new content and share via our social networks unreleased content more rapidly starting today. [h1]"Early Access" Build 4366[/h1] [list] [*] Fixed mp_roundlimit command so it now works. [*] Adjusted spawning order for players, fixing spawning near same players each round. [*] Fixed phone screen glitching when you or other players are on a ladder. [*] Fixed nav-mesh commands to allow better debugging of the navmesh for broken areas. [*] Fixed floating-roar glitch for zombies. [*] Optimised update text loading to lower number of main-menu freezing issues. [*] Added new Wrench weapon, first of the Kick-starter melee weapons. [*] Fixed infection effects copying over to other rounds when not infected. [*] Fixed crouch and jumping as a survivor stopping automatic weapon firing sounds. [*] Fixed nail-gun looping sound and glitching issues. [*] Adjusted overall spawning system for players, better and faster calculations. Also more spawns. [*] Zombie player jumping now limited by both stamina and delayed when taking damage. [*] Optimised player think timers to alternate per frame, less server load. [*] Added new, more detailed glass textures with the ability to shatter. [*] Fixed missing player zombie sounds, zombie players to use same system as AI. (Roar and Grapple) [*] Fixed GPS path sometimes not updating on dedicated servers. [*] Fixed AI survivors missing sometimes missing when using GPS on dedicated servers. [*] Fixed broken calculation of "Top Hunter". [*] Added new windows to Roanoke and Aurora. [*] More advanced reverb system for weapon firing indoor and outdoor. [*] Added fade effects when spawning and dying. [*] More glass in RPD is now breakable. [/list]
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-02-23_Build4366/Contagion_KS_Wrench.jpg][/url] Our First Kickstarter Melee Weapon (Still waiting on Email Responses, don't be shy!)
We we'll also be discussing new game-modes for Hunted and Zombie Panic fans! Be sure to check "What we're up to"/"In Development"/"Insert Name Here that fits" for more details of what to expect as well as either dates or hints at dates of release dates on our General Discussion Forums pinned at the top - http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][/url]
Some of us have taken our Vacation time to dedicate it to a proper Full Release! We want to thank everyone who posted bugs, helped us test, kept us motivated with kind words, offered constructive criticism, purchased or backed our game on Kickstarter and/or Steam! We won't disappoint (the many)! -The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Update 4259 with a significant game-mode feature
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][/url]
Sorry for the delayed post today but was out all night helping a friend and even I... I know it's hard to believe but I get hangovers too. The team worked hard to get another patch out to address existing issues, improve on lag compensation, optimization, and an experiment with Hunted we're very curious to hear what you all think. [h1]"Early Access" Build 4259[/h1] [list] [*] Adjusted scoring mode in Hunted to use new point system: 25pts for Last Man, 20pts for a Kill, 10pts for Zombie Player kill, 3pts for Zombie AI kill, -35pts for killing yourself. [*] Added speedhack and wallhack detection code to game. [*] Fixed phone ringtone connections in Hunted mode. [*] Fixed missing texture on Nicole's mouth. [*] Fixed looping baseball bat attack animation in thirdperson. [*] Fixed zombies bashing on a door after it's been broken. [*] Further optimised lag compensation code. [*] Fixed console spam from glass materials when on low video settings. [*] Fixed ability to use the changing name system to spam the chat. [*] Removed drawing of debug elements in the game when in Dedicated servers. [*] Recompiled Aurora Estates with brush-based houses for better looking detail on the map. [/list] Please keep us informed as to your thoughts good or bad and remember we're still working on another patch with content to go out shortly! A bit nervous about the new point system but we believe that this focuses on the many differences in how players play and have kept in mind the potential abuses and believe we've sorted it but we will have to learn this through you! We hope it plays out better than expected but it is in no way set in stone. Thanks for all those who have kept us up to date on bugs and more. Lucky to have thorough bug reports and keeping us motivated as we make progress! -The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Update 4209 is out and so is "Friday Frenzy" Ep 16 now on YT!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][/url]
Man is it cold as I try to type with frozen fingers. Many of you have had it a lot worse and we hope it's finally letting up with even some of our Dev's dealing with frozen pipes and lack of power. I personally love the winter but look forward to Spring for more than 1 reason! But back on track. We managed to find some time to take a breathe and put together this Patch and are already preparing another one which we hope to include one of our Kickstarter's Melee Weapons and more with a possible announcement shortly after. [h1]Build 4209 - Changelog[/h1] [list] [*] Fixed Zombie Player climbing so it's more consistent and user friendly [*] Fixed the bug where the phone's text is broken whene one adjusts their resolution or video options before playing [*] Fixed Eugene "ghost" or "clown" face bug for people with low settings (missing face texture when flashlight is shown on the player's face [*] Fixed zombie missing internal gib models glitch with melee weapon gibbing [*] Added our shotgun & scoped rifle unload feature (animations and sound) [*] Optimised bullet firing code improving on lag compensation further [*] Optimised lag compensation to take into account current game-mode and team (No lag compensation for other survivors for survivors as it plays no role in extraction etc.) [*] Fixed issue with ironsights counting as a firing event, further optimising the lag compensation [*] Fixed floating zombies or zombies dying when removing legs/gibbing of legs [*] Fixed shotgun not auto pumping while sprinting [*] Added melee and explosion gibs to player zombies [*] Fixed zombie players not dying the same way as AI zombies, (1 pistold shot instead of 2 for brainbox headshots mostly) [*] Optimised nailgun 'fake' barricade drawing code [*] Fixed glitch that allowed multiple players to play as the same character [*] Adjusted code for model changing when changing team (Still chasing zombie model survivor bug, hope we caught it) [*] Fixed weapon deploying after getting off a ladder [*] Fixed missing skybox textures for low settings and optimised heavily in the process [*] Created fully networked voice command system (On hold till we finish recording our Actors large list of responses) [*] Added voice volume detection system for characters, when to whisper, shout and speak normal for voice commands (as mentioned still on hold till we complete recordings in the studio) [*] New phoneme data system to work with our wWise sound engine [*] Optimised player code, removed unused functions related to timing and checks for obsolete code [*] Added leg gibbing animations for both male zombies [*] Optimised phone-system and made it more secure on server [*] Fixed bug with players not showing other players on the phone in Hunted [*] Fixed all phone systems when changing current item, whether that be player or objective [*] Fixed radio tower button in RPD that doesn't highlight like the rest of the buttons [*] Fixed pickup trucks not having proper alpha mask for random colouring of vehicles [*] Added 9-way look animations to survivor AI, preparing for motion capture animation setup [*] Zombies now don't push against RPD doors that are locked, allowing for kill exploiting [*] Nav_mesh fixes on ALL maps and additional clipping on maps to prevent escaping the world bounds [*] Sliding doors in RPD will not kill players any more. [*] RPD escape helicopter is now solid and will push players away when landing [*] Added additional key-spawns in RPD to help players who have issues finding keys (multiple keys spawned in multiple areas but still requires exploration) [/list] For those that missed last week's "Friday Frenzy" Stream & Giveaway here is an edited version on YouTube! http://youtu.be/TWGFz3lvD1c We know some have grown impatient and are either holding off until or fuming till we release new Content especially new maps. We're getting very close to a release for Barlowe Square (the largest Official Source Map ever created) with all hands on board and will be out asap as well as other new content. The wait will be worth it! If you're interested in our "Friday Frenzy" Stream & Giveaway you must partake in the http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0 channel chat and be following the channel itself!
[url=http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0][/url] [url=http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0]Official Contagion Twitch.TV Channel[/url]
We stream our Official Contagion "Friday Frenzy" via our Twitch.Tv Account at- http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0 every Friday @ 7:00PM PST/PDT (GMT- 8:00) [url=http://wwp.greenwichmeantime.com/time-zone/usa/pacific-time/]-Click here for current time-[/url] and will pass out one or more free copies of Contagion during the Stream! Happy to announce that Halleck Cui is back with us after his time at 2K Games and we couldn't be more excited as his work is professional and bringing part of the family back home is just a bonus. This will increase productivity and with us redesigning with enough nostalgia "CE_Biotec" also being worked on by Jason "DeeJ" Woronicz our old friend from NeoTokyo, he will play a vital role. The Announcements are coming and sooner than we expected! One of which was Biotec in today's announcement. Keep checking back for more as we reach the top of the hill and are able to release more and more at a steady pace.
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][/url]
-The Contagion Team

[*] Fixed Eugene "ghost" or "clown" face bug for people with low settings (missing face texture when flashlight is shown on the player's face
[*] Fixed zombie missing internal gib models glitch with melee weapon gibbing
[*] Added our shotgun & scoped rifle unload feature (animations and sound)
[*] Optimised bullet firing code improving on lag compensation further
[*] Optimised lag compensation to take into account current game-mode and team (No lag compensation for other survivors for survivors as it plays no role in extraction etc.)
[*] Fixed issue with ironsights counting as a firing event, further optimising the lag compensation
[*] Fixed floating zombies or zombies dying when removing legs/gibbing of legs
[*] Fixed shotgun not auto pumping while sprinting
[*] Added melee and explosion gibs to player zombies
[*] Fixed zombie players not dying the same way as AI zombies, (1 pistold shot instead of 2 for brainbox headshots mostly)
[*] Optimised nailgun 'fake' barricade drawing code
[*] Fixed glitch that allowed multiple players to play as the same character
[*] Adjusted code for model changing when changing team (Still chasing zombie model survivor bug, hope we caught it)
[*] Fixed weapon deploying after getting off a ladder
[*] Fixed missing skybox textures for low settings and optimised heavily in the process
[*] Created fully networked voice command system (On hold till we finish recording our Actors large list of responses)
[*] Added voice volume detection system for characters, when to whisper, shout and speak normal for voice commands (as mentioned still on hold till we complete recordings in the studio)
[*] New phoneme data system to work with our wWise sound engine
[*] Optimised player code, removed unused functions related to timing and checks for obsolete code
[*] Added leg gibbing animations for both male zombies
[*] Optimised phone-system and made it more secure on server
[*] Fixed bug with players not showing other players on the phone in Hunted
[*] Fixed all phone systems when changing current item, whether that be player or objective
[*] Fixed radio tower button in RPD that doesn't highlight like the rest of the buttons
[*] Fixed pickup trucks not having proper alpha mask for random colouring of vehicles
[*] Added 9-way look animations to survivor AI, preparing for motion capture animation setup
[*] Zombies now don't push against RPD doors that are locked, allowing for kill exploiting
[*] Nav_mesh fixes on ALL maps and additional clipping on maps to prevent escaping the world bounds
[*] Sliding doors in RPD will not kill players any more.
[*] RPD escape helicopter is now solid and will push players away when landing
[*] Added additional key-spawns in RPD to help players who have issues finding keys (multiple keys spawned in multiple areas but still requires exploration)
[/list]

notes.title: Contagion - Update 3918: Significant improvements to lag compensation and more!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][/url]
We hope you enjoyed your holidays! We definitely did but that did not prevent us from getting work done as promised. Barlowe Square and Pioneer Express are coming along fantastically and if all goes as planned we'll be seeing them in the public build next month. We're also making significant progress on our Linux and Mac platforms as well as our Dedicated Server and working on Sourcemod to help those running servers have more control.
[url=http://www.steamdevdays.com/][/url]
We've got so much going on it's a bit overwhelming but with the new hires we're blasting through it all. We've also got some interesting news that may reassure many or just irritate others (Playing our game for 2 hours a week apparently really gets on some ppl's nerves haha). Both Alex Wright (COO & Lead Animator) and Dec Doyle (Lead Programmer) are packed and flying out to Seattle, WA for [url=http://www.steamdevdays.com/?p=event]Steam Dev Days[/url] where we'll meet face to face with some of our friends and colleagues as well as improving relations with contacts and furthering our reach and experience that will benefit all. From there they will be flying to England for a few days (not even 24 hours rest) heading to our Motion Capture Studio where we've hired professional actors as we do a complete series of animations to replace the existing (it helps to have experienced and learned from our last MoCap session last year) animations for Player Survivors & Zombies, NPC Survivor (not all are friendly) & Zombies. With our layered animations and improved mechanics this will make a significant impact to immersion. Our guys have been at it without much free time to live their lives so very soon the work we've been on will be pouring in. Yes that means NEW CONTENT and we thank all of you (most of you) for the patience as developing a game is nowhere near as simple as some would lead you to believe. Early Access is/has been better than we could have ever hoped for and the cooperation of the community in helping us catch and reporting bugs and issues with the game that will make for a smooth Full Release!
[url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-01-13_Build3918/Contagion_Build3918_Screen01.jpg][/url] [url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-01-13_Build3918/Contagion_Build3918_Screen02.jpg][/url] [url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-01-13_Build3918/Contagion_Build3918_Screen03.jpg][/url] [url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-01-13_Build3918/Contagion_Build3918_Screen04.jpg][/url] [url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-01-13_Build3918/Contagion_Build3918_Screen05.jpg][/url] [url=http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-01-13_Build3918/Contagion_Build3918_Screen06.jpg][/url]
Here is this weeks changelog- [h1]Contagion "Early Access" Build 3918[/h1] [list] [*] Fixed & Improved lag compensation as well as hit boxes on both Survivor and Zombie players (Waiting for the told you so's heh) [*] Improved net-code update and latency timers [*] Fixed not being able to reload sniper and mossberg [*] Fixed missing bullet decals [*] Adjusted sound system update system for NPC's [*] Adjusted sound system state updating for player deaths [*] Fixed missing floor textures [*] Fixed stuttering while holding melee secondary attacks [*] Added melee weapon attack gibbing system [*] Removed melee attack stamina limit for primary attack [*] Melee swipe attacks now has the chance to do more damage to the head [*] Added grenade and explosion gibbing to zombies [*] Added non-fatal grenade explosion gibbing [*] Remade melee system again for steady reliability of attacking (WIP but definitely worth it in the end. notes.title: Contagion - Update 3918: Significant improvements to lag compensation and more!
notes.content:
<center>[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2013_09_13_Kickstarter/Contagion_Logo_450.png[/img][/url]</center>

We hope you enjoyed your holidays! We definitely did but that did not prevent us from getting work done as promised. Barlowe Square and Pioneer Express are coming along fantastically and if all goes as planned we'll be seeing them in the public build next month. We're also making significant progress on our Linux and Mac platforms as well as our Dedicated Server and working on Sourcemod to help those running servers have more control.

<center>[url=http://www.steamdevdays.com/][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-01-13_Build3918/Steam_Dev_Days_2014_450.png[/img][/url]</center>

We've got so much going on it's a bit overwhelming but with the new hires we're blasting through it all. We've also got some interesting news that may reassure many or just irritate others (Playing our game for 2 hours a week apparently really gets on some ppl's nerves haha). Both Alex Wright (COO & Lead Animator) and Dec Doyle (Lead Programmer) are packed and flying out to Seattle, WA for [url=http://www.steamdevdays.com/?p=event]Steam Dev Days[/url] where we'll meet face to face with some of our friends and colleagues as well as improving relations with contacts and furthering our reach and experience that will benefit all.

From there they will be flying to England for a few days (not even 24 hours rest) heading to our Motion Capture Studio where we've hired professional actors as we do a complete series of animations to replace the existing (it helps to have experienced and learned from our last MoCap session last year) animations for Player Survivors & Zombies, NPC Survivor (not all are friendly) & Zombies. With our layered animations and improved mechanics this will make a significant impact to immersion.

Our guys have been at it without much free time to live their lives so very soon the work we've been on will be pouring in. Yes that means NEW CONTENT and we thank all of you (most of you) for the patience as developing a game is nowhere near as simple as some would lead you to believe. Early Access is/has been better than we could have ever hoped for and the cooperation of the community in helping us catch and reporting bugs and issues with the game that will make for a smooth Full Release!

notes.title: Contagion - Update 3768 - XP Now Supported and Happy New Year Everyone!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][/url]
Contagion is still on sale for 50% off for a couple more days for the Steam Holiday Sale. Due to the sales we received a number of users excited to purchase games as quickly as possible to avoid forgetting later and this led to some neglecting to read the System Requirements where XP was not supported. We already put out a large patch before Xmas and had no plans to avoid works the rest of the year through the holidays so we put XP Support on our priority list and are very happy to announce Contagion now runs on Windows XP. We will continue to optimize and improve performance of the game hopefully leading to supporting lower minimum system requirements (will be adding XP to it soon as my kid stop's screaming into my ear). For those curious about Linux and Mac I can only say that we've made progress and are taking it just as seriously and will release as soon as possible. Like XP there is no ETA on when they will release but we hope that the above efforts show we do commit to our community and pull through even with turkey, ham, kids, trees, Xmas shopping, etc gets int he way haha. Here is the Changelog (Any complains about lack of Maps, Characters, Features, or Weapons will be removed as we've been clear about this for this update in past posts and due to unrealistic expectations. We're sorry but we'll add it when it's ready.) [h1]SVN BUILD 3768[/h1] [list] [*] Windows XP support! [*] Added Kickstarter backer graffiti tag rewards (Stay out of Tatsur0's house!) [*] Optimized Shader code to aid support of XP. [*] Fixed voice icon that hovers over the player's heads when using Voice Chat. [*] Fixed additional props from Christmas update. [*] New props added to Aurora Estates. [*] Fixed nav_mesh errors in Cyprus Park and RoanokePD. [*] Removed unused elements from menu. [*] Some stuff we forgot as we improved the maps and celebrated the Holidays at the same time. [/list] Also for those that missed it we made 2nd place in this year's IndieDB Indie of the Year Awards!
Thank you again for your support and keeping us humble and focused on the task ahead of us. -The Contagion Team

notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][/url]

We have less than 4 days to vote and many of us have selected our favorite released/un-released games and mods already wishing them all luck. It is our hope that this trailer will both entertain and motivate our community and interested parties to support Contagion and vote for us as Indie Game of the Year 2013! If not we're still grateful to be a part of these events.

notes.title: Contagion - Coming Update & Friday Frenzy Series
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][/url]
Contagion is currently participating in the Steam Autumn Sale and looks like our Daily 75% is over but the 50% is still available for a short time! Valve confused some numbers in favor of our fans so grab it cheap for $7.49 or for the 4 pack at $22.49 before the sale ends! But remember Contagion is still "Early Access" which means we've got quite a lot of new content, weapons, maps, features, and more to come like our upcoming patch which will include a new firearm which we'll reveal shortly (My favorite weapon of all time for those that know me). Of course after Full Release all DLC will be free as promised and we're still dedicated to releasing on Linux and Mac as well as releasing our SDK/Workshop so the community can do what they do best! Break my stuff :( J/K :D Keep the game interesting as we all love to overdo it and seek out our next fix. Why Contagion? Cause we had an itch to scratch and apparently we we weren't the only ones. After 10+ years of developing games focused on the Zombie Genre we sincerely feel we've got something spectacular. When we look at the custom built shaders, features, particles, assets, and soooo much more we find ourselves a tad overwhelmed by what we could accomplish until the community reminds us with their kindness and support. It's still important to research for yourself which is why we run a weekly Series/Giveaway giving back to those who've supported us through "Friday Frenzy". During this weeks episode we discuss our upcoming map Barlowe Square and more as well as some sillyness. Have a look before you commit to anything! We Stream every week and toss up on youtube soon after like the video below (sorry we cut out the 2hour Q&A's after each stream haha)

notes.title: Contagion - New Weapon, Performance and Restructure, and more update!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][/url]
We appreciate everyone's patience and as promised have focused on optimizing the game further. We've cut off roughly 1GB, increased load speeds, and should be more stable on more machines. Files have been compressed into VPKs for the benefit of the users and while this requires one large update now, future updates will not be as painful. Changelog- [list] [*] Optimised rendering code [*] Recompiled Shader code with newer C++ [*] Optimised post processing shader commands code [*] Fixed RPD navmesh in lots of places [*] Removed collisions from railings that get zombies stuck [*] Optimised RPD [*] Added new detail and fixes to RPD scripts and navigation [*] Updated aurora estates map and navmesh [*] New RPD guard station prop updates [*] New RPD weapons locker props and texture fixes [*] More ambient sound additions and overall mix to RPD [*] New shader optimisations [*] Adjusted gibbing system [*] Added Machete and new animations [*] Clipping added in RPD to prevent zombie 'hiding' [*] RPD navmesh fixes for stairs in the map [*] Skylight windows added to houses in suburbs [*] Optimised sound occlusion for Zombie AI [*] Optimised sound bank-file loading for memory [*] Fixed memory leak on game exit not unloaded memory allocated by large bank files [*] Removed occlusion and obstruction from ambient sounds, now using pre-calculated occlusion [*] Obstruction and occlusion added to player weapons and moving ambient sounds [*] Optimised zombie positional update code for sounds [*] Changed gib code to allow 9MM weapons to gib the head [/list] We are still looking into Nvidia issues, crash bugs, and further optimization. Unfortunately none of these issues were brought to light until we released "Early Access" so we need your help tracking down the problems. If you're having issues please visit [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/4/]Here[/url] and provide the following: [list] [*]Full Error in detail (what you were doing when the trouble occured, what if any message did you get, any other visual cues?) [*] Full System Specs... [*] What have you tried thus far? [/list]
We will be streaming on our Twitch.Tv Account at- http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0 every Friday @ 7:00PM PST/PDT (GMT- 7:00) [url=http://wwp.greenwichmeantime.com/time-zone/usa/pacific-time/]-Click here for current time-[/url] and will pass out one or more free copies of Contagion during the Stream!
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430][/url]
Next week we'll be focusing on further optimization and bugs as well as releasing a new Firearm. Maps will come in due time. -The Contagion Team

Contagion is Now Available on Steam Early Access!

Eugene, Marcus, and other Survivors return in the spiritual successor of the popular Half-Life 2 Modification Zombie Panic: Source!

Contagion is a cooperative survival horror FPS built on the latest Source Engine where players are forced to watch their ammo and aim carefully otherwise be overrun by the zombie hordes. Players will face traditional zombies as well as former teammates who have been turned themselves and where friend becomes foe fueling the carnage to come.

notes.title: What's our response to concerns regarding funding? ALSO SickJoe's Poster in the flesh!
notes.content:
[h1]What do you say to a backer who's concerned you're going to fail?[/h1] We get a lot of messages on our Kickstarter and Email showing concern about us reaching our goal of $50,000 and we get it. Kickstarter is no guarantee and some people think we're not Indie enough whatever that means heh. I always tell them the same "We're not concerned" for 2 reasons. We're nearly 50% of the way and just bout to hit the halfway point. Since 2003 while working on ZP1, ZPS, NeoTokyo, and then our start-up Monochrome developing Contagion I've been surrounded by fanatics! All of you fuckin nut jobs that I fell in love with and have done nothing but be there for me, the team, and our games. 10+ years of loyalty. I have no doubt that all of you will do your best to help us reach our goal. The second is simple. If Kickstarter were to fail to reach it's goal knowing you guys tried your hardest (or didn't cause Contagion wasn't for you which I would never hold against anyone and yes we're still working on ZP:S haha), you should know by now that I, the team, and our games get done. Contagion will release October 25th as planned unless another party were to stop us but we're pretty persuasive :) If you haven't pledged for Contagion on Kickstarter, we still have time. Visit our Kickstarter Page - http://www.kickstarter.com/projects/monochromellc/contagion (PayPal is unfortunately still not an option. We're still doing our best to work out a method that doesn't hurt you or the team.) OR DON'T! I just thought it fair to share why "we're not concerned" and show you all the respect you deserve for everything you've already done. Believe it or not :) Enough of me getting all emotional... FUCKIN A Love this god damn poster Joseph "SickJoe" created and then as a favor quickly got it printed and up on his wall (course he was going to get it done for himself anyway.....) We still have a limited number available on Kickstarter but just check it out and either love or hate it! We love it :D
[url=http://www.kickstarter.com/projects/monochromellc/contagion][/url]
He apologizes for the crappy camera but we forgive him cause asap we're having the team setup with a poster and a fresh Contagion T-shirt as we work with a new print shop. We know not everyone can back us financially but if we spread the word well enough we will make it! We've put together a simple 3 CLICK share page based off Soma's (deserve credit obviously) if you'd be willing to share and help spread the word!
[url=http://www.contagion-game.com/share/][/url]
We've also got a number of popular youtubers already releasing videos as well as more on the way! Check it out before you pledge/share. Thank you guys, -The Contagion Team (P.S. Lol wonder how many people bother to read all that. If so then also know that we're working on steamgifts again for another giveaway. Will keep you all updated.)

notes.title: What's our response to concerns regarding funding? ALSO SickJoe's Poster in the flesh!
notes.content:
[h1]What do you say to a backer who's concerned you're going to fail?[/h1]

We get a lot of messages on our Kickstarter and Email showing concern about us reaching our goal of $50,000 and we get it. Kickstarter is no guarantee and some people think we're not Indie enough whatever that means heh.

I always tell them the same "We're not concerned" for 2 reasons.

We're nearly 50% of the way and just bout to hit the halfway point. Since 2003 while working on ZP1, ZPS, NeoTokyo, and then our start-up Monochrome developing Contagion I've been surrounded by fanatics!

All of you fuckin nut jobs that I fell in love with and have done nothing but be there for me, the team, and our games. 10+ years of loyalty. I have no doubt that all of you will do your best to help us reach our goal.

The second is simple. If Kickstarter were to fail to reach it's goal knowing you guys tried your hardest (or didn't cause Contagion wasn't for you which I would never hold against anyone and yes we're still working on ZP:S haha), you should know by now that I, the team, and our games get done.

Contagion will release October 25th as planned unless another party were to stop us but we're pretty persuasive :)

If you haven't pledged for Contagion on Kickstarter, we still have time. Visit our Kickstarter Page - http://www.kickstarter.com/projects/monochromellc/contagion

(PayPal is unfortunately still not an option. We're still doing our best to work out a method that doesn't hurt you or the team.)

OR DON'T! I just thought it fair to share why "we're not concerned" and show you all the respect you deserve for everything you've already done. Believe it or not :)

Enough of me getting all emotional... FUCKIN A Love this god damn poster Joseph "SickJoe" created and then as a favor quickly got it printed and up on his wall (course he was going to get it done for himself anyway.....) We still have a limited number available on Kickstarter but just check it out and either love or hate it! We love it :D

<center>[url=http://www.kickstarter.com/projects/monochromellc/contagion][img]http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2013_09_13_Kickstarter/Contagion_Poster_IRL_STEAM.png[/img][/url]</center>

He apologizes for the crappy camera but we forgive him cause asap we're having the team setup with a poster and a fresh Contagion T-shirt as we work with a new print shop.

We know not everyone can back us financially but if we spread the word well enough we will make it! We've put together a simple 3 CLICK share page based off Soma's (deserve credit obviously) if you'd be willing to share and help spread the word!

<center>[url=http://www.contagion-game.com/share/][img]http://www.contagion-game.com/share/share-banner.png[/img][/url]</center>

We've also got a number of popular youtubers already releasing videos as well as more on the way! Check it out before you pledge/share.

Thank you guys,

-The Contagion Team

(P.S. Lol wonder how many people bother to read all that. If so then also know that we're working on steamgifts again for another giveaway. Will keep you all updated.)

notes.title: Find Tatsur0 as he server hops on ZP:S for a free copy of "Contagion" on Steam
notes.content:
I had hoped to do this on both Zombie Panic: Source and NMRiH servers but couldn't get NMRiH to work (I'm told it's caused by the 2013/Steampipe update) so I apologize to the NMRiH fans and hope you'll jump on ZP:S to find me! I'll be jumping in and out of Zombie Panic: Source servers from all over the globe giving away copies of "Contagion" the spiritual successor to ZP:S! Of course we're interest in Active gamers who are excited for "Contagion". I will start handing out keys at 6:00AM Pacific Time (GMT - 7:00) and throughout the day so we can get keys to users living in different timezones.
[url=http://www.contagion-game.com/share/][/url]
We tried Steamgifts but they never got back to us so we eventually gave up on it. We also know some players may be out of town or for whatever reason can't be in-game to grab a key. While unfortunate it's just the way it is. We apologize for the inconvenience but as always we can't make EVERYONE happy. I look forward to seeing you in-game! Just a heads up, I'll most likely be jumping on servers with Stock maps (Official ZP:S Maps) but may swing around to others later. Please do not PM and beg for keys I have been forced to ignore most requests for the past few months due to this. Best of luck! -Tatsur0

notes.title: New limited time exclusive Item for our supporters!
notes.content:
[url=http://www.kickstarter.com/projects/monochromellc/contagion][/url]
Because your support on Kickstarter means a great deal to us and our release, we've yet another incentive for those who pledge $15 (or more) tier. As a Kickstarter backer, whenever you enter a server/game it will unlock random spawns for the hands-free clip-on flashlight making you a valuable resource and everyone's new best friend. Weapons with flashlights will still work as they do now, but when you switch to any health item, objective item, melee weapon, the over and under shotgun, scoped rifle, kg-9, nail gun, or grenade you'll finally be able to shine some light and not stumble around in the dark. [h1]Contagion OST and Exclusive ZPS inspired ringtones[/h1]

Get the pre-released, mastered Contagion OST (Digital Soundtrack) or if you're hardcore Zombie Panic fan be one of the very few to have a set of ZP:S inspired ring-tones that will be hard-code to your phone for both you and others to hear but is a Kickstart Exclusive.

Current Progress: 25% (3 days after Launch of Kickstarter)

[b]Important Information:[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]If I pledge $15 (or more) will I be able to play right now?[/i] :: [b]Unfortunately no. Kickstarter doesn't actually charge anyone until the project has reached completion which in our case is October 13th, 2013[/b]
[*] [i]When do I get my copy of the game then?[/i] :: [b]For those who pledged $15 or more will receive their game as soon as the Kickstarter funds are cleared which is some time before October 25th giving you a head start.[/b]
[*] [i]Why not just wait till the Official Release on Steam?[/i] :: [b]We launched Kickstarter because we truly need the support of the community to help us pay off the last of the license fees, help us reach more interested gamers increasing our player base which is a win/win for all interested parties, and finally help with server costs to smooth things on release. [*] [i]What happens if you don't reach your goal?[/i] :: [b]If this happens no one will be charged or receive their tier rewards and we will receive nothing for all our efforts. That said we started this up knowing there were no guarantees and will do everything in our power to make sure we release on time October 25th with Early Access.[/b]
[*] [i]I'm a huge ZP:S fan and have played 9000 hours on it. Can I have a free key?[/i] :: [b]We love the enthusiasm and loyalty our community has shown us but if we gave every ZP:S fan a free key we'd go out of business. Sadly this is not an option.[/b]
[*] [i]Will you be passing out more Preliminary Beta Tester Keys[/i] :: [b]For right now no. We are doing our best to focus on Developing Contagion, Updating Kickstarter, and preparing for release.[/b]
[/list]

Alex is back from his anniversary in time to fix more animations and to celebrate my birthday! Good day!

Oh right and we're just a lil bit off from hitting 25% after 3 days. This is great news and we have more to come.

-Monochrome

notes.title: Contagion Kickstarter & Full Trailer Launching Friday the 13th also Free Keys!
notes.content:
Six days till Contagion's full trailer drops this Friday the 13th. We thought we'd spill a little more info on what to expect in tandem with the trailer. We're excited to finally be able to answer a lot of the burning questions we receive and show our project to the world. First up is a big milestone for us and all of you as well! We feel it's finally time to announce our plans for a Kickstater on 13th along with the full trailer. We're in our final stretches of development which means our Kickstater will come with all the information on pricing, release schedule, and most of the questions we've been asked since Contagion was announced.
Launching September, [b]Friday the 13th[/b]
The reason for this Kickstarter is to help us in the final stages of Contagion's development. Up to this point all development costs, licenses required to continue our work, our trips to GDC, PAX, and Gamescom, and much more has been all out of our own pockets and while we'd very much like to finish without asking, we're just so close and it's time we ask our community, fans, and hopefuls to help us reach the milestone that will get the ball rolling on it's own. We need your support to help in the final stretches of development. We hope to see our ZP:S, NMRiH, and new Contagion fans showing their support! We do have some even more exciting news for many! In just a handful of days starting on the 10th and running through the 12th we will be handing out FREE "Prelimanary Tester" Contagion Steam Keys. All keys will be handed out exclusively via this Steam Group so be sure to join if you haven't already. If you aren't a member yet, joining is just a click away! These keys won't just be for a beta but for the full game as our thanks for your support.
[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/contagion/news/contagion-teaser-trailer-pt-2-kickstarter-and-more]For an extended version of this post check out our indieDB page.[/url] -Monochrome

notes.title: INDIEpendence Day Giveaway!
notes.content:
We've hit 3,000+ Members on our Official Steam Group thanks to all of our fans support and to celebrate that accomplishment as well as Independence Day (I miss those BBQs living out here in Japan) we've planned a surprise! We are now launching the much anticipated "INDIEdependence Day Giveaway"! Starting at 12:00 NOON (PST) (GMT - 7:00) July 3rd we will be RANDOMLY selecting users in our Official Contagion Steam Group and Contacting/Putting them down on a list in case you're busy with family/travel for the holidays/timezones. That's one random Indie game given to one random member of the group every single hour for a full 36hours until 12:01AM (PST) (GMT - 7:00) July 5th. We don't expect a huge influx of users joining the group but if that is the case we've already decided that we will increase the number of indies we giveaway to compensate any large numbers joining the group as we want the chances of receiving a free Indie to be roughly the same. [h1]So once again, this is is how it's going to work[/h1] [list] [*] The INDIEpendence Day Giveaway starts at 12:00 NOON (PST) (GMT - 7:00) July 3rd and ends 36 hours later at 12:01AM (PST) (GMT - 7:00) July 5th [*] One random member will be selected every hour and be given a random Indie title (or if you're not available listed and announced to claim within the week before given to another member) [*]If our group member numbers increase for some reason significantly we will try and compensate with more titles being released per hour [*] This Giveaway is [b]EXCLUSIVE[/b] to our Official Contagion Steam Group so if you're not a member, now is the time to check us out and see if we're a group you're interested in (try to make it more about the game than the giveaway haha) [/list]
Many of us are not in the States or celebrate Independence Day so remember this has just as much to do with celebrating reaching 3k+ members so fast thanks to all of your support than it does with the holiday. We felt it right to give back and are fans of our previous Indie Giveaways. I love that feeling of "Will I get one?!" and hope you do too as we will be not playing any favorites and will use software to randomly select all those picked. [URL=http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/864972399736294792/]Here is the Member Pick List Discussion[/url] showing all those who have been selected. Look for your name and see if it's there. Update every hour on the hour as we select a new member for our Giveaway! Enjoy! -Monochrome
